articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Multi-modal Heterogeneous Medical Big Data Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: With the continuous deepening of social and economic development and medical reform, as well as the rapid development of some new technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data, and cloud computing, intelligent information technology combining medical and industrial has become a necessary trend. Among them, multi-source heterogeneous data fusion based on machine learning theory and supported by perceptual data has become a current hot research field, which is widely used in urban systems such as medical care, homes, and transportation. Massive perception data are generated in different fields or industries, and each type of data contains a large amount of unlabeled data, data sparse areas and domain knowledge, and there are big differences in these data types, data relationships and data quality. How to fully mine The information of single source data, and the fusion of these single sources of information, the establishment of a big data model based on these fusion information, and finally the establishment of an intelligent auxiliary diagnosis system, has become one of the important research contents. This article observes the patient's diagnosis and treatment process in the hospital, combines deep learning network and multi-modal data fusion technology, and uses deep semantic matching network to study the establishment of a hospital intelligent diagnosis and treatment auxiliary system, which provides a reference for medical big data detection and diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: Application of MATLAB Software in Multiple Integral Calculation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The calculation of multiple integral is the key and difficult points in Advanced Mathematics teaching. The calculation of multiple integral, which is relatively complex, needs to divide the multiple integral into repeated integral according to the integral region, and then the integral operation is carried out. In this paper, MATLAB software is used to intuitively and vividly present the graphics of the integral area to students. Hence, students can easily convert the multiple integral into repeated integral, which greatly improves their self-confidence in learning. Meanwhile, the application of the software can also help to solve the difficult problems in teaching and improve the teaching efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on enterprise production decision-making based on TOPSIS method
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Based on the ideas of TOPSIS method and linear programming, this paper establishes the enterprise raw material ordering and transportation model, and solves the following problems: using TOPSIS method, this paper comprehensively evaluates 402 suppliers, establishes the enterprise raw material ordering model, and gives the most important fifty suppliers to ensure the production of the enterprise. The variance of the expected supply quantity of raw materials in the future is calculated by Excel, and the variance of the expected supply quantity of raw materials in the future is the smallest, which is calculated by Excel; At last, the paper discusses how to make the lowest weekly loss transfer plan in the next 24 weeks under the condition of the loss rate of the forwarder.

articleTitle: Hybrid Distribution Model for Emergency Epidemic Prevention Materials in Urban Areas
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: To meet the demand for the emergency distribution of epidemic prevention materials in a pandemic quarantine area, a Vehicle-Drones hybrid distribution model is constructed. In this paper, vehicles are used to transport emergency supplies from the primary distribution center to secondary distribution centers and outlier customer locations. Drones are used at the secondary distribution center to deliver goods to customers in the quarantine area. In the first-level distribution, the DBKM algorithm is designed to screen outlier customer points in the quarantine area and uses the ant colony algorithm to solve vehicle route planning. In the second-level distribution, the AEGA algorithm is proposed for solving the drone path planning under the constraints of the time window and drone range restrictions. Finally, simulation verifies that this paper's "Vehicle-Drone" hybrid distribution model is more efficient than the traditional "Vehicle-Drone" joint distribution model in epidemic prevention materials distribution.

articleTitle: Depot constructions prediction model for expanding One-way Carsharing operations to a new city
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: With the continuous improvement of people's travel demand, carsharing has gradually entered the public eye. Different usage models have different requirements for the operation of enterprises. It is extremely important for one-way carsharing (OWC) company to predict long-term demand and then provide the basis for depot location and related constructions. Currently, the studies on OWC demand prediction took order quantity of the stations as demand simply, ignoring information of multiple small sub-trips among dwell events during one trip. To address this issue, this paper aims to further classify carsharing demand into three categories according to usage patterns and establish demand forecast models separately. Based on carsharing data in Lan Zhou, the factors that affecting the demand are extensively studied in operating area, including Point of Interest (POI), operational parameters, transportation facilities, and accessibility. According to the operation data, we can analyze the deep information of the trip chains. Additionally, the demand forecast models are used to estimate demand in a new area and serve depot constructions support. The approach can predict the potential demand for new cities, which can reduce the risk of supply-demand imbalance and improve the station utilization.

articleTitle: 1-D Convolutional Neural Network for Integrated Modular Avionics Fault Modeling and Diagnosis
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: With the development of integrated avionics, integrated modular avionics (IMA) system has become an important part of modern aircraft airborne systems. Once IMA fails, it will not only affect the operation of avionics functions, but also threaten flight safety. Therefore, it is necessary to carry out fault modeling and diagnosis, which can identify its failure cause accurately and improve its maintenance efficiency. Based on the IMA failure mechanism analysis and fault data, the 1-D Convolutional Neural Network is introduced in this paper to model the IMA system’s failure process and determine its failure cause, the effectiveness of the proposed method for fault modeling and diagnosis is verified by the experimental simulation in the end.

articleTitle: A Bandwidth Tunable Preamplification for Separating LFP / AP Signals
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to obtain the local field potentials (LFP) and action potentials (AP) hidden in the neural signal, and effectively separate the two signals, this study proposes a bandwidth tunable preamplification for separating LFP/AP signals. Unlike in the past, this study is performed by means of a MOS transistor controlled by an external clock, thus achieving the function of a switched capacitor band-pass filter. Effective separation of LFP (0.5Hz-300Hz) and AP (300Hz-10Kz) is achieved. It also reduces the chip area problem caused by the use of large resistors. Spectre simulations show that this bandwidth-adjustable preamplifier amplifies the LFP and AP signals while effectively separating the two signals.

articleTitle: Influence of the upper arch amplitude of track slab on the mechanical properties of vehicle-track system
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The CRTSⅡ slab track may produce the upper arch disease of the track slab in the extreme high temperature weather. Therefore, the static analysis model of the track structure and the dynamic analysis model of the vehicle-track coupling system are established by the ANSYS finite element software in this paper, and the influence of the upper arch amplitude of the track slab in the CRTSⅡ slab track on the mechanical properties of the vehicle-track coupling system is explored. The results show that under the action of the train static load, the maximum values of the rail vertical displacement, the track slab vertical displacement, the track slab longitudinal stress and the CA mortar layer stress increase with the increase of the upper arch amplitude of the track slab; under the action of the train dynamic load, the vibration acceleration of the vehicle, the wheel-rail force, the wheel load reduction rate, the rail acceleration and displacement, the track slab acceleration and displacement and the derailment coefficient increase with the increase of the upper arch amplitude of the track slab; When the driving speed is 300km/h and the upper arch wavelength of the track slab is 3.25m, the upper arch amplitude of the track slab should not exceed 6mm.

articleTitle: Study and application of numerical calculation of advance bearing pressure of roadway under different mining height
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The coal-seam occurrence conditions of Yuandian No. 1 Coal Mine in Huaibei were taken as the engineering research background in the work to explore the distribution laws of abutment pressures ahead of the roadway under two mining processes. The theoretical analysis, numerical calculation, and engineering reality measurement method were used to study the peak position and suffering area of the advanced abutment pressure of the return airway under two mining processes at working face 824. The results showed the significant influence of the mining height on plastic and elastic zones. In the fully mechanized mining stage, the bearing pressure reached a peak at 2 m ahead of the coal face, and the maximum value was 20 MPa. At the stage of com-prehensive top-coal caving, the bearing pressure at 8 m ahead of coal mining reached a peak, and the maximum value was 17.38 MPa. The suffering areas were 42 and 53 m, respectively. The bolt (cable) spacing of the roadway was optimized to improve the stress environment and bearing capacity of surrounding rocks in the roadway. The research results can provide an advanced support basis for sublevel mining at working face 824.

articleTitle: Application of data statistics and image method in the classification of mound tomb form in the circum-Taihu region
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Based on the archaeological excavations and research data accumulated over the past 60 years, From a statistical and graphical point of view this paper identifies the variables of the mound tomb morphology, such as the sealing soil and the burial chamber, and delineates the different classes of variables, which are important variables for analyzing social iden-tity and constitute the main components of property elements, observing their social hierarchical differentiation and deciphering the social meaning implied behind each element.

articleTitle: Construction of forensic identification data analysis platform system based on big data technology
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Based on big data technology, combined with JavaWeb application development technology, the design and construction of forensic identification data analysis and management platform is realized under the Hadoop architecture. The system can effectively take advantage of the application advantages of network information technology and the characteristics of various data analysis and processing tools under big data technology. In order to solve low-level problems, it is proposed to construct a new mode of forensic identification management in the form of the integration of data-based, networked, and informatized judicial technical work and forensic identification innovation, and propose a set of feasible comprehensive application solutions. The system will meet the actual needs of judicial administrative organs, with the design concept of both management and service, and with the design goals of convenience, efficiency and practicality, to promote the improvement of the forensic identification management system, deepen the sharing and collaboration of data information resources, and provide a large-scale judicial system. Forensic identification management provides a good foundation to better promote the modernization and informatization construction of forensic identification management.

articleTitle: Recognition Method of Motorized Traffic Mode Based on GPS Data
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: A clear understanding of the urban residents' travel behavior can serve as the foundation for traffic management and control measures. This paper proposes a mode recognition method for urban residents' travel behavior based on GPS data. With the GPS data preprocessing, feature fitting and machine learning, the algorithm is designed to recognize three common motorized traffic modes: bus, taxi and private car. The machine learning algorithm based on neural networks is used to recognize taxi and private car by learning the differences between peaking frequency, speed, acceleration and jerk. The average recognition accuracy is 83.84 percent, which shows this method has high recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: HIC: Named Entity Recognition Based on Enhanced Boundary Detection and Span Classification
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The traditional named entity recognition based on sequence labeling can only assign one label to each character during prediction, which cannot solve the case of nested entities. This chapter starts from the idea of solving nested entities, and introduces a dual affine attention mechanism in the boundary detection module, so that the head and tail pairs can interact and enhance the boundary of the entity explicitly. At the same time, combined with the traditional sequence labeling model, the internal character relationship between the head and tail pairs is modeled to avoid the influence of non-entity words between the head and tail pairs. Finally, the detected head-to-tail pairs are classified by the span classification module.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Vertical Profile of Small Coaxial Dual-rotor UAVs Based on the Energy State Method
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: At present, the optimized trajectory of vertical profile is mostly realized on large passenger aircraft. In this paper, this optimization is extended to unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) by optimizing the trajectory for the longest possible range considering the given battery power and altitude. Taking the self-developed small coaxial UAV as an example, firstly, the motion model of the aircraft is obtained through mathematical modeling, and the mathematical model of the flight cost is obtained through the optimal control theory. Based on the energy state method, only the cruise and descent phases of the vertical flight profile of the aircraft are considered, the optimization simulation is carried out by particle swarm algorithm and Matlab's bvp4c function in stages, and the optimal flight trajectory in the vertical flight profile of the aircraft is finally obtained. The optimization results are obvious, and applying the vertical trajectory optimization to the UAV can help to increase the range by 7.6%.

articleTitle: Realization of magnifying glass function based on mask and position in e-commerce website
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In the era of big data and Internet, various e-commerce websites are booming. How to help users buy their favorite goods quickly and efficiently has become a concern of users. The mask layer based on positioning can provide a stable mouse movement area, which provides a guarantee for stably obtaining the coordinates of the mouse pointer. The magnifying glass designed with mask and position technology can easily drive the movable layer behind the mask to select the commodity area to be enlarged when the mouse moves in front of the mask, thusly realize the commodity amplification function. The realization of the magnifying glass function facilitates users to carefully observe the details of goods and provides convenience for users.

articleTitle: Ship motion visual simulation display system based on Unity3D
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Displaying the motion state of ship under different sea conditions can provide immersive design experience for ship designers, provide design basis for optimal design of ships, and also provide decision-making information for ship managers during navigation. By using Unity3D simulation engine and taking the Yuming ship as the object, A ship motion visual simulation display system based on Unity3D was developed by combining the typical marine conditions. The display system was tested by setting different marine conditions, and the results showed that: The system can reproduce the ship motion under different sea conditions.

articleTitle: Application in Waterway Navigation Evaluation Based on Flood Combination of Main and Tributary Rivers
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The flow conditions of the tributaries affected by the backwater of the main stream are complex, and the flood combination of the main stream and tributaries is random. Based on the historical flood conditions of hydrological station on the main and tributary rivers, the extreme flow conditions that may occur at the bridge site are analyzed and the combination of the main and tributary river floods is studied. The controlling factors related to navigation clearance dimensions and navigation flow conditions are studied and numerically simulated by two-dimensional hydraulic model. By comparing the parameters of navigation water level and flow condition in different working conditions before and after building the bridge, the results show the influence of engineering implementation on waterway and provide relevant basis for engineering decision-making and reference for hydrological analysis of similar projects.

articleTitle: Lubricating oil component detection algorithm based on characteristic peaks
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Based on the point data obtained by NMR technology, the NMR spectrogram analysis model is established, and the original file output of the NMR spectrometer is first identified, converted, and the spectrum is established. Then the established spectrogram is analyzed, and the results are obtained by using the model proposed in this paper. Based on the material detection algorithm of the characteristic peak and the similarity analysis algorithm, the model in this paper not only considers the relationship between the number of characteristic peaks, the chemical displacement corresponding to the known substance, and the characteristic peak of the unknown sample but also considers the influence of the peak intensity of the characteristic peak on the experimental results. This model analyzes and detects the NMR spectra of various known lubricant additives and unknown samples. The experimental results obtained from multiple dimensions are more comprehensive and reliable than those obtained by the traditional Nei coefficient and non-uniformity methods.

articleTitle: Research on the influence mechanism of job crafting on the suggestion behavior of the new generation of employees based on system dynamics simulation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In the VUCA era, the work of the new generation of employees is the potential power source of enterprises. Their suggestion behavior plays a very important role in the innovation and development of enterprises. This paper will explore the impact mechanism of job crafting on employees' suggestion behavior. Based on the theories of job requirements resource theory, self-determination theory and social exchange theory, this paper believes that job crafting has a positive impact on the suggestion behavior of the new generation of employees, the sense of professional mission plays an intermediary role between job crafting and employees' suggestion behavior, and the sense of organizational support positively regulates the relationship between the sense of professional mission and employees' suggestion behavior. The influence mechanism of job crafting on the suggestion behavior of the new generation of employees is simulated and analyzed, and finally some ways to improve the effectiveness of management are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Platform for Railway Transport Station
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In view of the status that current systems for railway transport station meanly focus on functional integration, partial information sharing and business-based data mining, which can’t meet the requirements of scientific decision and intelligent execution. The architecture of big data platform for railway transport station is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the online real-time data collection technology based on Internet of Things is adopted, the operating parameters of the systems and equipment is collected by the Internet of Things gateway. Using StreamSets component, data visualization ETL is realized, and the data quality and reliability is improved. Secondly, based on the unified data flow management, the data collection, integration and transparent access are realized, and the processing logic global scheduling for the platform is implemented. Finally, the data development models by the visual studio suite are constructed rapidly. And the platform supports secondary development for railway transport station business. It realizes efficient and low-cost data asset construction and data analysis application. And based on data-driven it provides technical support for quality improvement and business innovation.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Consumption Prediction of Urban Rail Transit Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In recent years, our country attaches great importance to the development of rail transit, Urban rail transit system has become one of the most important ways of travel in people's life. Therefore, it is of great theoretical and practical significance to analyze the energy consumption of rail transit, and give energy saving and emission reduction measures according to the results. This paper first studies and summarizes the relevant concepts and prediction methods in the energy consumption prediction field of urban rail operation, and finds that the technical effect of BP neural network is good and relatively common. Therefore, according at the energy consumption of urban rail transit, this paper constructs the energy consumption prediction model based on BP neural network based on the real energy consumption data of a line of Nanjing metro. The input layer of the initial prediction model is 14 influencing variables. After error detection and model training, the average accuracy of the model energy consumption prediction reached 96.15%.In order to reduce the computational complexity of the model, make the model play more value in practical application, this paper and on the basis of the initial model model, using the grey scale correlation analysis, variable reduction, established the input layer for eight variables energy consumption prediction model, model after simplified average accuracy reached 96.55%, also has a good prediction effect.

articleTitle: Analysis of passenger flow characteristics index based on bus IC card data points
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: From the perspective of stations, this paper takes passenger flow level and operation service level as evaluation dimensions, and selects the passenger flow ratio, time imbalance coefficient and the variation coefficient ratio of stations as evaluation indexes. The results show that the passenger flow of different bus lines in the same bus station varies at different times, affecting the frequency and scheduling plan of different bus lines. It is beneficial for enterpriser to start from the bus station and consider the coordinated optimization scheduling between bus lines, thus reducing the number of bus vehicles used in the station and operating costs. This study aims to better grasp the overall situation of the yard station and provide data support for the subsequent schedule optimization of the yard station and vehicle scheduling problems.

articleTitle: An Optimization Framework for Developing of 3D Uniform Magnetic Field Generator
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to solve the problems of high order derivation and confidence assessment of the optimization results in the optimal design of multi-coil homogeneous magnetic field, an optimal design method of multi-coil homogeneous magnetic field based on the combination of intelligent optimization algorithm and finite element method is proposed. Firstly, the parameters to be optimized are determined and the deviation rate of magnetic field is used as the objective function; then, the intelligent optimization algorithm is used to find the optimum of the objective function; finally, based on the optimized structural parameters, the corresponding finite element simulation model is established to check the credibility of the optimization results. The simulation results show that the optimal parameters obtained by this method are better than those obtained by the traditional derivative method, and the reliability of the optimization results is ensured after the finite element method.

articleTitle: Research on Equipment of Marine Reef Unmanned Floating Platform Information Platform
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The total length of China's continental coastline from north to south is about 18,000 kilometers, and its island coastline is more than 14,000 kilometers. There are numerous coastal islands, but most of them are unattended. Sovereignty maintenance and maritime law enforcement has always been a problem, among which the lack of effective information platform and equipment is the core problem .Therefore ,an unmanned information platform equipped with an information system is proposed .Platform choose based Marine equipment fixed form, design a kind of comprehensive situational three-dimensional perception information platform and using the flexible base caisson gravity base, and Marine energy autonomous system using solar energy is given priority to, platform equipment set "feeling, transfer, use, tubes" in a body, can rapid prototyping, a large number of replication, the maneuverability is strong ,It can effectively expand China's geostrategic advantage in the South China Sea islands .At present, equipment has completed deployment demonstration in the South China Sea, serving as a "maritime sentinel" to realize information defense on remote uninhabited islands and reefs in China.

Index Terms: Islands In The South China Sea

articleTitle: Analysis of the Peak Voltage of Parabolic Antenna Coupled Output under UWB-HPM Pulse Irradiation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: This paper analyzes and simulates the radar output peak voltage under the irradiation of ultra-wideband high-power microwave pulses with different center frequencies. The results show that when the narrowband radar receives highpower microwave radiation, due to the filtering characteristics of the radar antenna and the uneven distribution of the spectral energy of the bipolar Gaussian pulse, the radar output voltage is related to the radar bandwidth, the total power of the irradiated signal and the relative position of the radar and the center frequency of the irradiated signal, part of the energy does not enter the radar receiver, resulting in a decrease in the radar output peak voltage.

articleTitle: Carbon emission calculation of regional electric vehicles based on LCA method
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Under the goal of carbon peak and carbon neutral, focusing on the carbon emissions of electric vehicles in different regions is of profound significance to promote the electrification of the transportation industry. However, previous calculations of carbon emissions of electric vehicles are mostly concentrated in a single province or the whole country. Therefore, this paper determines the life cycle carbon emission accounting boundary of electric vehicles in the driving stage according to the life cycle assessment (LCA) method, and considers the prediction of electric vehicle ownership in each region. The carbon emissions of electric vehicles in different regions were calculated, and the historical stage, shortterm and medium-term change trends were given, so as to put forward relevant suggestions on promoting clean power structure and improving transportation electrification around electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Fire Early Warning System of Substation AC power supply Based on BP Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to effectively identify the unsafe factors of substation AC power supply and give effective early warning of fire accidents, in this paper we analyze the change mechanism of various sensing data in the process of substation AC power supply fire. Then, based on multi information fusion method, BP neural network algorithm is used to analyze and monitor the risk factors of fire in station AC power supply, and a fire early warning algorithm based on BP neural network is proposed. Based on this algorithm, a station AC power fire early warning system is proposed. The test shows that the system can quickly identify the factors that may cause fire accidents in the station AC power supply and give early warning in advance, which provides a valuable reference for the application of station AC power supply fire early warning engineering.

articleTitle: Research analysis of networked command information system based on complex network technology
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Command and control network is the nerve center of the whole combat network. The characteristics of command information system and complex network map to each other. Complex network technology provides the possibility to solve the networking problem of command information system. In this paper, the structural model of command information system is established by using the relevant theory of complex network, and its three levels are networked respectively. Through the simulation analysis of different network modes, it is obtained that the networking of command information system structure is conductive to the analysis of the overall performance of the system and the design and optimization of network structure.

articleTitle: Research on coal supply information monitoring and risk early-warning method in power industry
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In the context of the energy internet, the energy and power industry chain, which centers on the power industry, faces the problems of long coordination, poor information fusion, and lack of monitoring and early-warning methods for the primary energy supply. In this paper, from the perspective of the power industry, a coal supply information monitoring and risk early warning system framework covering the whole chain of coal supply chain, such as production, transportation, storage, transaction and consumption, is constructed; then, the index system, which includes the whole link information of coal supply chain, is established to monitor the important information which affects the security of power supply and the stability of market price. At last, the early-warning method are put forward which focus on the risk of coal price fluctuation, coal inventory and coal contact, providing references for information monitoring and early-warning methods of coal supply chain and system development in power industry.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of the influence of container ship berthing time at port under epidemic situation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: COVID-19 has had a significant impact on international logistics chains and normal port operation efficiency. The epidemic in Shenzhen on May 21, 2021 led to a serious decline in the operation efficiency of the initial container port and port congestion. This paper conducted statistical analysis on the waiting time at anchorage and the berthing time at terminals of major container ports in China, and studied the composition of container ships stopping time at port under the normalized epidemic prevention and control. It establishes the calculation model of the number of ships and days at anchorage, and reveals the mechanism of port congestion caused by the increase of ships stopping time at port. The result shows that reducing the average time at port to less than 24 h is very useful to alleviate port congestion, so the optimization strategy of container ship stopping time at port is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on order policy based on multi-stage dynamic programming
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to study the problem of selecting suppliers and ordering different categories of raw materials, a decision-making method combined with evaluation models and dynamic planningis proposed based on relevant data from suppliers between 2016 and 2020. Firstly, an evaluation model applying gray correlation analysis and entropy weight method is developed to narrow down the range of suppliers waiting to be selected, and then a multi-stage dynamic planning model is established to make a decision on the order policy. After that, it is analyzed empirically. And the final results demonstrates that the selected suppliers supply raw materials stably, the order policy is feasible for long -term implementation and the total cost of it is low.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis of constant voltage output control of MCWPT system based on SN topology
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In the MC-WPT system, the change of spatial position between the transmitting and receiving coils will cause the mutual inductance to fluctuate, and the load of the system also fluctuates within a certain range, resulting in the non-constant output voltage of the system. The article establishes a simulation model of the Magnetic Coupling Wireless Power Transfer (MC-WPT) system based on Series-None (SN) topology by Simulink and COMSOL simulation software, introduces a single-ended primary inductor converter (SEPIC) at the input of the primary-side inverter and uses a PI regulator to realize the constant voltage output of the system, analyzed the coil mutual inductance and the voltage output when the load fluctuates in a certain range. And verifies the validity of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Research on city informatization level based on entropy method and system clustering method
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In this paper, 21 cities are selected as research samples. Firstly, the evaluation index system of informatization level is constructed from five aspects of urban economic development level and information industry development level. Secondly, the relevant index data of these cities in recent years were collected, and the weight of each evaluation index was obtained by using entropy method to calculate the data. Then calculate the comprehensive score of informatization level of each city. Finally, 21 cities are classified by systematic clustering method according to the level of informatization. The classification results verify the rationality of entropy method to study the level of urban informatization. Based on the research results and comprehensive evaluation ranking, this paper analyzes the status quo of informatization construction in some cities and puts forward corresponding countermeasures and suggestions for informatization construction.

articleTitle: Research on radar jamming resource scheduling based on deep reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In this paper, the autonomous decision-making method of the scheduling of radar jamming resource for remote support jamming aircraft is investigated based on the actual combat requirements using remote support jamming aircraft to cover penetration aircraft. First, the decision-making for the scheduling of radar jamming resources for remote support jamming aircraft is analyzed. Subsequently, a model of radar jamming resource scheduling is built. Next, a decision-making method of the scheduling of radar jamming resource for remote support jamming aircraft is proposed based on the proximal policy optimization (PPO) algorithm. Lastly, for typical combat scenarios, simulation experiments are performed in the simulation environment deduced by electronic countermeasure. As revealed by the experimental results, the PPO algorithm can drive the agent to determine the jamming frequency and release the jamming beam in the process of radar jamming, which has high real-time performance.

articleTitle: High-resolution remote sensing water extraction based on improved U-net
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Aiming at the problem that water body extraction from high-resolution remote sensing images is easily interfered by irrelevant information such as vegetation, buildings, roads, etc, this paper proposes an improved model to better improve the effect of water extraction. In this paper, we introduce an efficient channel attention mechanism in the coding region to enhance target features. Dilated convolution and pyramid pooling modules were introduced to expand the receptive field without losing the resolution, and multi-scale context information was captured by different dilation rates. In this paper, we use the self-made GF-2 remote sensing image water dataset for training and evaluation. The experimental accuracy rate reaches 98.47%,the F1-score and IoU are 0.9311 and 0.9829 respectively. Compared with the FCN model and the original Unet model, the proposed model avoids the interference of vegetation and buildings, and has the advantages of high precision and low noise.

articleTitle: Research on the Effectiveness of Equipment Support Supply Chain in Operational Tasks
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: It is the cornerstone to achieve diversified tasks in the complex social background, which includes reliable equipment and material supply capability. This paper attempts to quantify the key aspects of equipment and material supply chain (hereinafter referred to as EMSC) security: equipment and material reserves, equipment performance assessment, mission objective analysis, and optimal combination of material supply varieties, coordination and optimization of hierarchical relationships, simulation and rehearsal of the operational reliability of equipment, use of integrated functional optimization design and example security effectiveness assessment, etc., and striving to better play the EMSC management strain in the process of mission practice. In the process of mission practice, we strive to better play the role of supply chain management, control, and flexibility to achieve optimal integration of equipment and materials, efficiency and quality improvement. However, there are many aspects involved in the management of equipment and materiel for the mission, so we can only demonstrate the important aspects of the guaranteed supply chain within a limited scope, aiming to provide valuable suggestions for the smooth operation of the supply chain and guarantee the maximum reliability of the mission.

articleTitle: Attention-based multi-level image and text sentiment analysis
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: People are keener and keener to express their opinions and share their lives on social media. Analyzing this information with an apparent emotional tendency has broad application prospects. Since the multi-dimensional characteristics of each modality and the interaction between modalities have not been considered in the previous graphic emotion analysis, this paper proposes an emotion analysis model (BRFANet model) based on various neural networks and attention mechanisms. Firstly, ALBERT and BiGRU are used to capture the deep semantic information of the text. Secondly, residual network and Faster RCNN combined with PFN are used to capture the image's global and local features, respectively. Then, to capture the target object that can better reflect emotions, the text features are used to guide attention interaction on local images. Finally, the self-attention network is used to automatically identify the key weights of each mode to complete the fusion. On the Flickr dataset, compared with the traditional multimodal sentiment analysis method, the classification accuracy and F1 value are improved, proving the model's effectiveness.

articleTitle: Investigation of Numerical Simulation Methods for Single Shear Tests of Root-soil Composite
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to carry out a better and faster study on the mechanism of root consolidation, this paper selects a typical Banyan taproots and red clay soil in Hainan to carry out a numerical simulation study on single shear test of root-soil composite, introduces the numerical simulation technique of root system embedded in soil to simulate root-soil interaction, finds that the elastic modulus is not constant during the shear process, and proposes the method of "two-point control method" to determine the elastic modulus of soil effectively. Comparative analysis of shear stress-shear displacement curves, shear deformation and root deformation by experiments and numerical calculations showed good agreement, and the correlation coefficients all reached 0.99. The research results provide a theoretical basis and method for subsequent single-shear experimental research on the influence factors of root consolidation, and have a certain reference for guiding the practical engineering problems.

articleTitle: MRI Segmentation of Brain Tumors based on Multi-scale Feature Fusion and Residual U-Net
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Brain tumor segmentation is a vital part of medical image processing, which aims to assist doctors in making accurate diagnoses and treatments. It has significant practical value in the field of clinical brain medicine. MRI is the primary method to diagnose brain tumors, but the fuzzy and adhesion of brain medical images make it difficult to obtain accurate results by manual segmentation. Therefore, we propose a residual network with multi-scale feature fusion based on UNet. This model uses encoder, decoder and skip connection architectures to reduce semantic gaps between networks. We selected the Dice coefficient as a metric, and the higher the Dice coefficient, the better the model’s performance. Compared to other U-Net variant models, the Dice coefficient of our model is improved by between 2% and 4%. The experimental results show that our model is superior to other U-Net variant models in the segmentation task of brain tumors.

articleTitle: A Novel Node Importance for Road Networks Considering the Distance Between Indicators
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The importance indicators of nodes can reflect the dynamics and operation efficiency of a road network, and their evaluation is a vital part of road network planning. Different node importance indicators are all determined by the topology structure of a road network. Traditionally, the combination weighting method, which combines the subjective analytic hierarchy process with the objective entropy weight method, is used to assign weight to each node indicator and thus generate an integrated indicator to quantify the importance of nodes. However, this integrated indicator ignores the influence of the distance between indicators. To overcome these shortcomings, this paper proposes a novel method for evaluating the importance of nodes, which introduces a distance influence coefficient to improve the traditional gray correlation analysis. Finally, we provide a numerical experiment to demonstrate the proposed novel method. The numerical results show that the method proposed in this paper can more efficiently evaluate the importance of nodes and can serve as a basis for planning a road network.

Index Terms: Importance Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: The Application and Thinking of Space Information Technology in Outdoor Sports
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: With the continuous improvement of people's living standards and the increase in leisure time, outdoor sports have become one of the ways for people to fitness and leisure. However, outdoor sports have a wide activity area, long duration and a complex environment. Therefore, outdoor sports have certain risks and uncertainties. As a physical spatial distribution feature information technology, spatial information technology can provide corresponding data information for outdoor activities. Using spatial information technology to provide comprehensive, systematic, high precision information, security of outdoor sports, risk prevention and control, activity process monitoring, evacuation and clearing to ensure the smooth progress of outdoor activities and interdisciplinary research, space information technology can provide more powerful technical support for outdoor sports.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysing of High Efficiency and Power Density Telescopic Magnetic Coupling Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Wireless power transfer (WPT) technology with non-physical contact effectively solves traditional power transfer problems. High efficiency and power density is the development trend of WPT. In this paper, a novel magnetic coupling mechanism of the WPT system for mining, seabed, and aerospace is designed. The magnetic flux density of the inner and outer cylinders of the coupling mechanism is different. Therefore, the reasonable design of the magnetic core size can greatly reduce the magnetic loss and weight. In addition, a series-none resonant topology is used to reduce the complexity of the secondary circuit. Finally, the size of the coupling mechanism is limited to Phi 70 ×70 mm, and the simulation results show that the system realizes 4.3kW power transmission at a 10mm transmission distance, and the efficiency is 86.1%.

articleTitle: Data security storage method of power grid asset system based on blockchain
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Blockchain technology has been widely used because of its centralized characteristics. Considering the current data security storage method of power grid asset system, due to the cumbersome data encryption process, the data storage and processing time is long, which affects the data integrity, a data security storage method of power grid asset system based on blockchain is proposed. Use the blockchain packet storage optimization algorithm to optimize the amount of blockchain data storage; Complete the data block encryption through homomorphic encryption technology; On the basis of data block encryption, the data integrity verification method is used to verify the data. So far, the design of data security storage method of power grid asset system based on blockchain is completed. The experimental results show that this method can reduce the data storage response time and improve the data integrity to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Trajectory Clustering-Based Controller Preference Identification Under Convective Weather
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to accurately analyze controller preference under sequential convective weather, the paper proposes a trajectory clustering-based controller intention identification method for convective weather scenes. Firstly, the approach flight trajectories are resampled by using the uniform parameterization method; then the approach trajectories are clustered by using DBSCAN (Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise) algorithm, and the central trajectories of traffic flows are identified by using K-means algorithm; then the trajectory clustering results are combined with the convective weather images to extract controller intention. Finally, the paper carries out case studies on typical scenes in the terminal area of Guangzhou. The results show that the proposed method can accurately identify controller intention under sequential convective weather. The results verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: MAMFuse: Multi-modality Image Fusion with Multiscale Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Merging multi-modality images aim to integrate valuable information from various source images into the same image for human perception. Infrared and visible images have unique imaging modes, and their complementary information fusion can be widely used in night monitoring, detection, and tracking. However, the existing fusion strategies cannot clearly distinguish between target and background regions in the image. Consequently, we propose a fusion strategy of a multi-scale attention mechanism called MAMFuse. The attention mechanism can capture typical information without losing details and suppress the image noise interference in the fusion stage. We adopt the nested encoder-decoder unsupervised learning structure. Meanwhile, MAMFuse includes an encoder group, a fusion strategy, and a decoder group. The encoder group extracts the original features from the infrared and visible spectrum. And the obtained original aspects are input into a multi-scale attention module to obtain attention features. Then, two attention features are multiplied by elements to obtain the target attention feature. Original features and target attention feature constitute the final reconstruction feature. Finally, the decoder group generates fused images by reconstruction feature. We conduct qualitative and quantitative experiments on the seven fusion methods, which proved the effectiveness of MAMFuse.

articleTitle: 2019-NCOV Propagation Model Based on Cellular Automate and SEIR Model
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: With the rapid spread of the new coronaviruses worldwide, it has caused large-scale outbreaks and global public health problems. This paper uses the discrete characteristics of cellular automata in time, space and state, based on local conversion rules, and considers the population classification of SEIR model, taking the infectious ability of the infectious individuals to the susceptible, whether to intervene in the virus transmission and the intensity of the intervention and other factors as the model parameters of the cellular automaton, Constructed a new coronavirus pneumonia propagation model based on cellular automata and SEIR model. Experimental results show that the proposed propagation model has a good simulation effect on the epidemic situation, which proves the effectiveness of the method and provides a theoretical basis for the prevention and control of new coronavirus pneumonia.

articleTitle: A fast implementation of a SAR intra-vein convolutional modulation algorithm
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The implementation of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) intrapulse convolution modulation has the problem of a large amount of calculation and poor real-time performance. This paper proposes a fast realization method of SAR intrapulse convolution modulation based on a Field-Programmable Gate array (FPGA) to solve the above problems. Firstly, the time-domain template completes the Fast Fourier transform (FFT) offline and sends it to the FPGA for storage. After that, the multi-channel interpolation calculation is performed on the radar pulse signal online through the FPGA. Replacing time-domain convolution with a time-frequency product can improve real-time performance and reduce resource occupancy. Simulation and field experimental results demonstrate the feasibility of the scheme. The practical simulation test result is compared with multiple groups of implementations, which proves that this implementation has a more incredible implementation speed than the Personal Computer (PC)and Digital Signal Processing (DSP).

articleTitle: Study on Temperature Distribution of the Surface-mounted Evaporative Cooling system for High Performance Computer
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: With the development of high performance computer, the heat flux density of cabinet becomes higher and higher. Then the traditional air cooling may bring great energy consumption. The evaporative cooling technology provides a new method to solve the cooling problem. The cabinet contains multiple heat resources, then the surface-mounted evaporative cooling system has a complex parallel structure. So in this paper, the temperature distribution may be studied through experiment. Based on the combination of experiment results and theoretical analysis, the liquid volume and operating pressure was proposed as the key factors to affect the temperature distribution. Lower temperature level can be got under less liquid volume and lower pressure. Moreover, the mode of parallel about unit with different size and heat load also has influence on temperature.

articleTitle: Research on health status evaluation method of switch machine based on ANFIS
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Aiming at the problem of uncertainty and randomness of mechanical failure of ZYJ7 switch machine, a multi parameter switch machine health state evaluation model based on subtractive clustering adaptive fuzzy neural inference system (SC-ANFIS) is established. Through the research and demonstration of experimental data, this evaluation method can better solve the fuzziness and complexity of the factors affecting the health of switch machine, provide reference for maintenance personnel and reduce the maintenance workload.

articleTitle: Optimizing Traffic Flow Forecasting Model Based on Spatial-Temporal Analysis
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: To optimize the reasonable dispatch of limited highway resources, the accuracy of traffic flow prediction plays an important role in alleviating road congestion. In this paper, the historical traffic flow time series data are deeply mined, divided into three time series data with different space-time attributes, and then the three time granularities are matched in space-time to form a sequence of information with three space-time attributes at the same time. The simulation results show that based on the same model, the divided sequence information has more potential information characteristics than the original sequence under the same capacity, and the performance of the network model can be further enhanced.

articleTitle: Automatic Vertical Parking Path Planning Based on Clothoid Curve
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to solve the problem of automatic parking of vehicles under the non-zero initial heading angle, this paper proposes a vertical parking path planning method based on the clothoid curve. When the parking space position and size, vehicle position and heading angle are known, the vehicle can adjust the heading angle by clothoid curve combination, and drive to the designative parking point to complete the parking. The analysis of vehicle outline curve, trajectory curvature change curve and vehicle heading angle change curve shows that the path planning method can effectively solve the problem that the initial heading angle is not 0.

articleTitle: Construction of digital twin system for mechanical safety test bed
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: This paper proposes a digital twin system for safety early warning visualization, with an aim to stimulate a safety-conscious mindset among students and researchers during product design. The digital twin system of the final mechanical safety test bed is developed based on the digital twin theory. First, a digital twin is established for the experimental platform and scene in the twin layer. Second, data is acquired from the manipulator, controller and sensor, using the Internet of Things (IoT) platform. Finally, the collected data is used to drive the model to synchronize with reality, realize the mapping of the twin model to the physical object, and form the digital twin system of the final mechanical safety test bed. The research results show that the twin system can enhance the breadth and depth of teaching materials for mechanical safety as well as the cutting-edge nature of teaching methods. Students can also gain a deeper understanding of the concept of digital twins.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of terahertz photoconductive antennas with different electrodes
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low radiation power of terahertz photoconductive antenna, three different geometric electrodes are proposed in this paper. The photoconductive antenna with different electrodes is simulated in full-wave based on the finite element method, and the electric field, potential and transient photocurrent of terahertz radiation is obtained. The simulation results show that the peak value of the transient photocurrent of the interdigital electrode is the largest, which is much larger than that of the linear electrode photoconductive antenna because the interdigital electrode greatly enhances the ability to collect carriers. The detailed simulation process in this work provides a certain reference value for researchers to study photoconductive antennas.

articleTitle: Short-term energy forecasting based on GBRT and time lag correlation coefficient
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Energy forecasting is a very important research topic in the field of electric power and energy. Accurate energy forecasting can provide support for enterprise production arrangement and energy management, which is conducive to achieving energy saving and maximizing production efficiency. Since energy variation is affected by numerous factors, choosing appropriate input features is the key to improving the accuracy of energy forecasting. In this paper, a GBRT short-term energy forecasting model is established, a feature selection method based on time lag correlation coefficients is introduced to select the sub-equipment loads with high correlation to the total load as input features. Calendar variables, historical load variables, and trend variables are designed to describe cycle characteristics, time series characteristics, and economic impact of loads, respectively. The results based on an industrial energy case show that the GBRT prediction model established in this paper can provide a certain degree of interpretability and has excellent prediction accuracy, and the proposed feature selection method can effectively improve the prediction accuracy of the energy prediction model.

articleTitle: A Image Steganography Scheme Based on Auxiliary Classifier Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the current generative steganography based on generative adversarial networks (GAN) couldn’t control the content of the generated image, this paper proposed an image steganography scheme based on auxiliary classifier generative adversarial networks (ACGAN). Firstly, ACGAN was trained by random noise and tag information to get the generator controlled by tag information. Secondly, the extractor network was trained by the generated image to get the trained message extractor. The images with different contents could be generated after training according to the specific environment for steganography, which could effectively avoid the exposure of the communication process and enhance the security of the communication system.

articleTitle: Value analysis of user consumption behavior based on XGBoost model and K-Means model
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of the Internet, digital online learning methods have become a new way for people to receive education. In this paper, user attributes and behavioral data of an online education platform are selected as samples, and the original data are pre-processed because the original data set contains a large amount of noise. Then, principal component analysis is adopted to determine the optimal number of features, and correlation analysis is used to select mutually independent features, and finally a feature set of 33 features is constructed. Based on the constructed feature set, the XGBoost model was used to predict the users' final purchase intention, and the prediction effect of the XGBoost model was found to be good based on the accuracy rate, F1 index and AUC index. Finally, the RFM key features are constructed by combining the feature importance score map drawn by RFM model and XGBoost model, and a reasonable user value assessment model is established by using K-Means clustering algorithm to divide users into 3 categories, and then feature analysis is conducted on different user groups to compare the customer value of different types of customers, so as to develop corresponding marketing strategies.

articleTitle: A Shifted Windows Detecting Method for Similar Plant Diseases Based on Transform
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Plant disease is one of the main threats to crops, and the identification and detection of plant leaf diseases with high similarity is a key and complicated technology. The mainstream approach is to use the CNN architecture to deploy the model. Unfortunately, the disease effect is not ideal. Instead, this paper proposes a method to identify similar diseases using Shifted Windows detecting with transform architecture. In multi-head attention in the structure, we use cross-attention instead of self-attention to improve the detection of confusion brought by similar features. The experimental results show that the algorithm achieves an mAP of 35.7%.

articleTitle: News Recommendation with Knowledge Graph and News Popularity
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KG) have shown great success in recommendation. This is attributed to the rich attribute information contained in KG to solve data sparsity problem and improve item and user representations as side information. However, existing knowledge-aware news recommendation methods didn't consider the contextual information of knowledge entities. In this paper, we propose KGNP, which obtains the contextual information of the entity such as frequency and position through a context embedding layer. In addition, we propose to incorporate news popularity as the contextual information about news to alleviate differentiation and the cold-start differentiation problems of personalized news recommendation. Then a Long Short Term Memory network is applied to the user embeddings by user's history click sequences. Experimental results demonstrate that KGNP can improve the accuracy of news recommendation.

articleTitle: Multicast Recovery Algorithm for Multilayer Multi-domain Optical Networks Based on Hybrid Swarm Intelligence
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: To address the problems such as link failures in various multicast services, this paper combines the artificial fish model and non-cooperative game for intra-domain path search based on the optical network architecture of PCE, and also uses an improved fruit fly optimization algorithm to find the recovery path, so as to improve the convergence speed while obtaining a better local or full search path selection. An analytical comparison with other swarm intelligence algorithms shows that the designed MIAMA algorithm has fast convergence speed, short recovery time, and can reduce the blocking rate in harsh environments.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Characteristic Analysis of Digital TV Broadcast Signal on Account of Data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Digital TV and digital band are playing an increasingly important role in people's life, and even play a key role in some segmented video channels. Digital TV usually has good quality, strong interference rejection, wide range of action and many other beneficial effects. At present, digital TV technology is becoming more and more perfect, and relevant band standards have been established. However, due to the need to obtain higher quality digital TV broadcast signals, the researchers have intensified the research and development of digital TV broadcast signals and made efforts to improve the processing ability of signal fuzzy characteristics. Among them, DTTB has outstanding characteristics: sufficient transmitting energy, wide signal range and high broadband performance. This paper studies the fuzzy characteristic analysis of digital TV broadcast signal based on data mining algorithm, and analyzes the process of fuzzy characteristic analysis of digital TV broadcast signal. The test results show that the fuzzy characteristic analysis of digital TV broadcast signal based on data mining algorithm can effectively enhance the fuzzy characteristic analysis of digital TV broadcast signal.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Power Allocation in Road Cycling Based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: This paper presents a framework to tackle power distribution problems in cycling time trial using power curve and simulated annealing algorithm. Based on the standardization of the power curve according to the energy distribution, our framework builds a kinematics model and uses the violence search method to get the approximate optimal solution of each track. Using a proposed perturbation method, we optimize the power distribution using simulated annealing algorithm. We apply our framework to real competitions and conduct a sensitivity analysis, which includes individual characteristics of competitors, wind conditions and personal estimation error. By extending our framework to the team time trial, we analyse its extensibility and the ability to provide people with information about heuristic strategies.

articleTitle: The Similarity Calculation Method of Multi-Warehouse with No Fixed Storage Under Complex Constraints Goods Location Planning Task
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Because of the complexity of multi-warehouse without fixed storage goods location planning problems, it takes a long time and heavy computing burden to solve the problem using traditional algorithms. Therefore, it is proposed using solving the similarity between the calculated tasks and the existing task, selecting the scheme with the highest similarity and recommend it. First of all, the constraints that may affect the good location planning scheme are analyzed. Secondly, the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is used to get the weight of each constraint condition. Then each constraint is treated dimensionless by normalization method and the similarity calculation formula is used to solve the problem. Finally, it is verified by an example. This method is proved to be practical and feasible, provides a new idea for solving complex goods location planning problem.

articleTitle: Reliability simulation analysis of mechanical performance of transmission tower structure
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: As the important station in power transmission, the safe reliability of transmission tower is directly related to the safety and economical operation of the whole power system. The unsteadiness of transmission tower is caused by permanent load, wind load and ice load, and they are the important factors for the damage of the power transmission. By establishing a finite element model, its global stability of transmission tower was analysed, and the reliability index and failure probability under different working conditions were obtained. The results can be used as the safe reliability criterion of the power transmission.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between Bangdi frequency and flute hole
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Aiming at the intonation problem in the production process of Bangdi, the structure of Bangdi is modeled and analyzed by using the method of electric-acoustic analogy, and the equivalent circuit diagram and spectrum diagram corresponding to each pitch are obtained. The relationship between pitch frequency and structural parameters of Bangdi is further explored. It is found that pitch frequency increases when the aperture of flute hole increases, and the simulation experiment proves that the pitch frequency can be adjusted by adjusting the aperture of tone hole in actual production. Compared with the formula method, the experimental results obtained by the acoustic-electric analogy method are closer to the theoretical value of pitch frequency, and the accuracy of pitch frequency is no less than 99.09%. Therefore, it can be considered that the method is suitable for the study of the acoustic characteristics of Bangdi.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection Method Based on FSSAE and GRU
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: For the sake of settling this issue that multi classification accuracy of current intrusion determination algorithms for network intrusion is generally not high, in view of the time series characteristics of network intrusion data, a network intrusion determination method of feature selection stacking sparse autoencoder gated recurrent unit (GRU) is suggested. For the sake of settling this issue of wide distribution and strong discreteness of primary attack information, firstly, the data are encoded and normalized, and the XGBoost algorithm and Spearman relevant coefficient are used to choose information characters. Then, the stacking sparse autoencoder is applied to draw features of the information. In the end, GRU completes training of model and realizes the classification. The consequences indicate precision of the suggested approach of the above data sets can reach 99.53%, which is 1.90% higher than that of the same type of SSAE-DNN.

articleTitle: Research on key technologies and development trend of Video Conference System
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Video Conference system is playing more and more important role in the work with the advent of COVID-19. The government, enterprises and the education are all ensuring the normal work continue in the form of video conference. This paper describes the classification and characteristics of video conference system, and then analyze the key technologies and future development trend of video conference system, which can provide direction and support for the construction of video conference system in the future.

articleTitle: Network Traffic Anomaly Detection Based on Deep Q Network
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The new generation of innovative technology has been widely used in all walks of life, so that the dependence of related business on the network has been strengthened, and the importance of network security has become increasingly prominent. The increasingly severe international security situation and the complex and changeable struggle situation also put forward higher requirements for the development speed of cyberspace defense capability and the construction degree of security facilities. As an important part of cyberspace security defense system, the abnormal network traffic detection system is also ushered in a new opportunity under the promotion of intelligent development trend. Based on the application of deep learning in the direction of cyberspace security, this paper chooses anomaly detection as the research goal, and proposes an unsupervised anomaly detection method based on Deep Q-network a single class of the long-term and the short-term memory networks, which can combine the powerful feature extraction ability of deep learning to create a tight envelope around normal data, and help to identify large data sets. Identify and defend potential threats and APT attacks in strong confrontation scenarios in a timely manner, and provide strong support for the improvement of cyberspace security technology system.

articleTitle: LGSAN: Latent Graph Structure Aware Network for Traffic Forecasting
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Precise traffic prediction, the cornerstone of intelligent traffic systems, has never been more crucial than it is now, thanks to the surge in smart cities and urban computing. Traditional approaches have recently been surpassed by graph neural networks. Most classic GNN-based models, on the other hand, perform well when given a preset graph topology. Existing approaches for defining network structure only consider spatial relationships and disregard temporal dependencies. Moreover, the semantics of static preset graph adjacencies used during training are always inadequate, neglecting the fundamental topology that may help the model be fine-tuned. To overcome these issues, we present the Latent Graph Structure Aware Network (LGSAN), a new traffic prediction system. The model uses a multi-layer perceptron and a KNearest Neighbor-based graph generator to acquire latent network topology information from the full data set while taking into account both spatial and temporal dynamics. Furthermore, by initializing MLP-kNN-hybrid based on true adjacency matrix and similarity measure by kNN, LGSAN aggregates topologies concentrating on geographic and node similarity.
