The produced graph is also fed into the spatiotemporal basic feasible, which combines diffusion graph convolution with a gated temporal convolutional network. LGSAN outperforms several kinds of state-of-the-art baselines in real-world experiments using two benchmark datasets.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Control Algorithm for Anti-Sway of the Overhead Crane in the Unmanned Storage Area
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Anti-sway system is the core technology of the automatic operation of the overhead crane. During the intelligent and automatic operation of the overhead crane, the appropriate anti-sway control algorithm plays an important role in the traveling efficiency and operational stability in the storage area. In practice, it is difficult to establish an accurate mechanism model because a number of factors interfere with the system operation. In this paper, a fuzzy control method is used to design the controller and it is applied in a steel plant, where the overhead crane is able to travel efficiently and stably, the control accuracy meets the site process requirements, and the stability of the fuzzy controller is verified.

articleTitle: Influences of interpretations of boundary conditions on nonlinear finite element analysis of a concrete column under near-field blast loading
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Due to the accompanying severe consequences of explosions, the blast puts a great threat to public security. Nonlinear finite element analysis is a possible method for civil engineers to check the integrity of the structures under blast loading without underestimating the limit of the structures. However, different interpretations of the boundary conditions may lead to huge differences in computational expenses and analytical results. Therefore, how should civil engineers simulate the boundary conditions to gain relatively accurate numerical results with acceptable computational efforts is of great interest. In this article, 5 different interpretations of the same physical situations are discussed, and experimental results are used as the baseline for judgment, which could help to indicate the proper simplifications in the set-up of finite element models.

articleTitle: Leakage risk analysis of ethane tank group based on FEM numerical calculation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Large quantities of flammable and explosive ethane are stored in large ethane storage tanks. Once the leakage occurs, it will cause great harm to the surrounding people, property and atmospheric environment. At present, there are few studies on leakage and diffusion of ethane storage tank group. In order to better study the leakage and diffusion laws of ethane storage tanks, this paper uses fluent software to simulate the leakage and diffusion process of ethane storage tanks. A twodimensional numerical calculation of ethane tank leakage was carried out. Firstly, the influence of wind speed on leakage and diffusion of the ethane storage tank was analyzed, and then the influence of leakage rate, leakage hole, and leakage location on leakage and diffusion of the ethane storage tank were analyzed. The results show that the leakage and diffusion of ethane storage tanks are greatly affected by the ambient wind speed. As the wind speed increases, the diffusion range of ethane expands. As the leakage rate of the ethane storage tank increases, ethane diffusion is not affected by the environmental wind speed. Leakage rate and environmental wind speed will cause ethane diffusion gas clouds under certain conditions, which will do great harm to the environmental area near the storage tank. With the increase of leakage holes, the diffusion concentration range of ethane leakage is wider. When the tank leaks against the wind, the environmental wind speed has the greatest influence on ethane diffusion, which has the widest diffusion area and the largest gas cloud concentration area. The results can be used as a reference for the prediction of leakage and diffusion of ethane tank groups and can provide a reference for the formulation of emergency protection strategies.

articleTitle: Research on Rumor Governance Strategies from the Perspective of Stackelberg Game
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The prevention and governance of online rumors has always been the core problem that the government needs to solve urgently. This paper introduces the two-person zero-sum Stackelberg game into the study of rumor management, in which the governor generally educates the public to improve the public's ability to identify rumors when daily or unexpected events occur, and the rumor-monger makes his own decision after observing the actions of the governor. Finally, an analysis of the game process leads to the conclusion that evenly educating the public on ideological education over a certain period of time by the governance party is the optimal strategy to avoid the creation and spread of rumors.

articleTitle: A Hidden Services Port Hopping Approach for Moving Target Defense
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Traditional network defense approaches are insufficient to deal with new types of network threats. Active defense approaches based on software defined network helps to solve this problem, which includes random port hopping technology. Existing port hopping approaches have problems such as the inability to completely hide the service port and the complicated hopping mechanism. In this paper, a hidden services port hopping approach for moving target defense is proposed, which uses port names to access the server and deploys to the pox controller to solve these existing problems. The algorithm and the process of proposed approach are presented. The analysis and experimental results show that the proposed approach can effectively realize the complete hiding of the real service port and expand the port hopping space to the entire port range. In the end, the setting range of port hopping frequency for reference is given.

articleTitle: Convergence analysis of extrapolated relaxed Hermitian and skew- Hermitian splitting iteration methods for large sparse linear complementarity problems
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: We investigate the problem of solving large sparse linear complementarity problems. First, we propose an extrapolated relaxation Hermitian and skew-Hermitian splitting iteration method for solving large sparse linear complementarity problems. Then, the convergence theory of thematods is established when the coefficient matrix is a positive or an H - matrix.

articleTitle: Research on the prediction model of total retail sales of social consumer goods based on Monte Carlo simulation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The sudden outbreak of COVID-19 has quickly spread to the world, causing a major negative impact on the economy. The circulation industry is also the first to bear the brunt, the total retail sales of consumer goods plays an important role in indicating the development of the circulation industry. Based on this practical problem, this thesis analyses the characteristics of the total retail sales of social consumer goods, and proposes a method using Monte Carlo simulation to select out the optimal prediction model from three models: ARIMA model, grey model, and Long-Short Term Memory recurrent neural network, in order to provide a reference for the forecast of total retail sales of social consumer goods. The results show that the total retail sales of social consumer goods has the characteristics of an upward trend and periodic fluctuations, and the grey model has a good prediction effect on the total retail sales of social consumer goods.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Construction of System Capability in the Simulation Training Commanded with Electronic Countermeasures
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: This paper analyzes how the system capacity has been required in the simulation training commanded with electronic countermeasures and introduces how the knowledge graphs of system capability has been put into specific utilization at the three stages of preparation, practice and assessment of this training. It is proposed which aspects should be underlined in establishing this knowledge graphs, so as to provide a reference for the further establishment of the knowledge graphs of system capability in support of the simulation training commanded with electronic countermeasures.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of hybrid autonomous robotic fish platform for underwater emergency search and rescue
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Underwater emergency search and rescue is an important part of emergency search and rescue of water traffic accidents. In view of the limitations of the current underwater search and rescue methods based on frogmen, the long-range and long-endurance fluid bionic structure of underwater robotic fish and the modularization of lightweight portable underwater sensors are designed, and the underwater robot (robot fish) platform is developed to realize the functions of route planning, data transmission and underwater remote control. Tests show that compared with traditional technical means, autonomous robotic fish has the advantages of high braking, portability and quick perception, which can meet the requirements of underwater emergency search and rescue missions under various conditions and effectively guarantee the safety of human life and property.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of the Changshui River Water Flow Flood of Cao'e River Sluice Operation Based on Two dimensional Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The construction of Cao'e River sluice has a significant impact on the drainage of Shaoxing river network. Different gate opening times have different degrees of impact on the decline of water level and elevation and the change rate of flow velocity in a certain period of time. In order to find out the optimal opening time to ensure that the Changshui River network has the least impact on the lives of local residents when the flood comes, this paper establishes a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model of the river network and analyzes the overall change of Changshui River during the opening of the sluice. Through simulation calculation, the relevant data of the river 72 hours after the opening of the gate are obtained and analyzed. According to the given water level increase rate and time change, when the rainstorm is coming, the Cao'e River gate needs to be opened 9 hours ago, and the drainage function of Changshui River can be optimized.

articleTitle: Study on the location of inland port of container port under the mode of intermodal transportation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to change the situation that long-distance container transportation still adopts highway transportation and solve the traffic congestion and environmental pollution caused by it, this paper proposed to establish inland container ports operated by road-rail intermodal transportation mode, in which goods are gathered to the inland ports by highway transportation and then transported to the ports by special railway. This paper established the optimization model of minimum total cost and uses CPLEX to solve it. The reliability of the model and the rationality of inland port construction are proved by analyzing the results of the model, comparing with the cost of highway transportation, and analyzing the sensitivity of freight volume after transshipment.

articleTitle: Application of Geographic Information System in Route Selection of Transmission Line Survey and Design
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Overhead transmission lines, an important carrier of power transmission, are the national power infrastructure. Whether the route selection design is scientific and reasonable directly affects the safety and reliability of power supply and economic rationality. The application of Geographic Information System (GIS) technology to the survey and design of transmission lines can improve the traditional survey and design methods, which is conducive to the information management of power grid enterprises and the construction of digital power grid. This paper takes 500KV transmission lines as an example to illustrate the application of GIS technology in the selection of line surveys and design routes. Through the establishment of a transmission line information platform，the paper carries the transmission line planning, route selection and pole tower position pre-arranged. The optimization of electric power line route and tower position can shorten the survey and design period of the project, reduce the project investment, and have huge social and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Design And Implementation of Digital Signature Architecture Based on Chaos and SM2
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to avoid the key leakage caused by the attack and destroy the security of the password, this paper mainly proposes the design and implementation of an improved digital signature system based on SM2 algorithm. In the original digital signature system, the pseudo-random sequence generated by the chaotic system is introduced into the digital signature system as the key to realize a high-performance digital signature system, which is implemented on the ZYNQ platform according to the computational characteristics. SM2 algorithm has a large number of parallel operations, which is more suitable for PL hardware implementation. In order to reduce the utilization of hardware resources and realize highperformance hardware design, this paper selects and improves the fast computing algorithm to realize high-performance hardware architecture. The chaotic system selects the classical logistic map and generates a random sequence as the key after iterative quantization. Parallel operation is not involved in chaotic iteration, so it is transmitted from PS terminal to PL terminal through DMA. The working frequency of the digital signature architecture proposed in this paper is 100MHz, and each signature takes about 5.41ms.

articleTitle: Assessing the spatial-temporal variability of net primary productivity in Qinghai-Tibet Plateau based on Google Earth Engine platform
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Based on Google Earth Engine (GEE) platform, combined with NPP, land use and climate datasets, this study analyzed the spatial-temporal patterns of NPP variations in Qinghai-Tibet Plateau from 2001 to 2020 using linear trend analysis, and explored the response of NPP to climate change and human activities. The findings are as follows: From 2001 to 2020, the spatial distribution of NPP in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau demonstrated a decreasing trend from southeast to northwest. Except for forested areas in the eastern and southeastern parts, NPP values were relatively low in other regions. The evolution trajectory of vegetation NPP in Qinghai-Tibet Plateau during the past 20 years exhibited significant spatial heterogeneity. Approximately 94% of the vegetation in the study area had been restored to some extent. There was significant spatial-temporal variability in the comparative roles of climate change and human activities during the NPP transformation in Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, and the restoration effect of climate change and human activities on vegetation was significantly more pronounced than the degradation effect. Compared with the traditional desktop remote sensing processing platform, GEE platform enabled rapid invocation of massive online resources, thus providing strong technical support for large scale and long time series remote sensing data.

articleTitle: Research on a field road network generation algorithm
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: This paper proposes a field road network generation algorithm, which is composed of road extraction algorithm and field road network topology generation algorithm. The road extraction algorithm includes the description of road network elements, the construction of road network topology, multi criteria network topology and so on. The field road network topology generation algorithm includes the description of field road network relationship data and road network fusion based on scattering construction method. Combined with the actual project, it has achieved good results.

articleTitle: Development and application of urban intelligent emergency platform system
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Intelligent emergency system is to build emergency big data governance system and data resource pool by using Internet of things, big data, cloud platform, 4G, wired network and various emergency rescue technologies. Relying on big data full stack technology and multidimensional data fusion analysis ability, so as to support various emergency business systems and data analysis applications. At the same time, using technologies such as natural language processing, knowledge atlas and data modelling, we will build an "intelligent emergency brain" for application fields such as natural disasters, safe production and urban safety. By building intelligent emergency comprehensive management system, emergency monitoring platform system, emergency disposal and rescue system, introducing the ant colony algorithm in intelligent optimization algorithm into the emergency scheduling model, the resource planning of emergency management information is carried out. Establish a comprehensive, standard and quantitative emergency information account, clarify the data description, provide mandatory technical constraints on data, and build an emergency management data governance system and data resource pool, so as to provide data support for its disaster prevention, mitigation and disaster relief business. At the same time, various emergency assessment models are established based on GIS, including various information processing models, geoscience models, analysis and verification models, natural disaster emergency assessment and pre assessment models, impact assessment models and disaster assessment models, so as to realize the rapid assessment of disaster. Through comprehensive analysis, research and judgment, the visual display of various emergency information can be realized. Realize the real-time monitoring and early warning analysis and management of infrastructure, natural disasters, production safety and other information within the jurisdiction, provide a unified view of the comprehensive operation status of the jurisdiction. Therefore, by establishing an intelligent emergency model, we can intelligently provide resource scheduling suggestions for various types of accidents and disasters. Various communication means such as wired, wireless and satellite are used to realize the functions of one key rapid distribution of command and dispatching information, emergency resource tracking and positioning, task tracking and feedback, etc. It also can realize the business application mobility of on-site emergency rescue, improve the efficiency of emergency office and disposal.

articleTitle: Terrain Visual Simulation Modeling Technology Base on Agricultural Machinery Simulation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: According to the requirements of agricultural machinery simulaltion for the terrain visual database, the paper defines the function and performance requirements of terrain visual database, it designs and models which are related to agricultural machinery simulation terrain visual database modeling. Firstly, it discusses the process of developing terrain visual database based on Creator18/Terra Vista Pro22. Secondly, it raises forward specific methods for the key technologies in the visual database model, including data preprocessing, 3D model and optimization, terrain generation and so on. The proposed technology and data have been has realized the function and performance requirements of the agricultural machinery simulated terrain visual database, and achieved the expected effect before ensuring the real-time performance.

articleTitle: Residual snow road adhesion coefficient modeling and safety vehicle speed evaluation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In view of the the residual snow road driving dangerous neglected, and the frequent accidents of traffic problems, this paper studies the residual snow in the microscopic characteristics of the road, the characteristics of it coverage is used to define the residual snow pavement, build six different coverage of the residual snow pavement, design experiment measured the impact of the key factors affecting the adhesion coefficient of safety driving speed; Then the linear model and nonlinear model of residual snow coverage rate and road adhesion coefficient were fitted by the least square method. After evaluation, it was found that the curve fitting results of the exponential model were most consistent with the actual road adhesion coefficient. Finally, the induced value of safety speed on residual snow road surface is evaluated by vertical value analysis, and the adhesion coefficient and safety induced speed of residual snow coverage rate are obtained.

articleTitle: Dynamic shared autonomous vehicles dispatching algorithm
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Numerous studies have shown that shared autonomous vehicle (SAV) ride-sharing models are beneficial for achieving low cost, low energy consumption, and low congestion for travel. However, an analysis of existing shared autonomous vehicle ride-sharing modes shows that existing modes suffer from inefficient ride-sharing. To address this problem, in this study, a dynamic detour ride-sharing mode (DDRM)as a new ride-sharing mode is proposed, and a dynamic SAV ride-sharing model for with the multi-objective of maximizing passengers' ride-sharing sharing distance ratio and minimizing their total travel time based on this new mode is formulated. According to the constraints of the model, a new passenger ride-sharing intelligence algorithm that determines passenger requests-analysis passenger matches-optimizes matching is designed, which solve the dynamic ride-sharing matching model with Hungarian algorithm in this study. In simulation results, the algorithm framework is able to provide quality dynamic ride-sharing solutions in real time, and the DDRM showed a much higher ride-sharing rate (the ration of the number of passengers who participant in ride-sharing to the total number of passenger) and more significant ridership benefits compared to the non- detour ride-sharing mode. The dynamic detour ride-sharing method of shared autonomous vehicle studied in this study can achieve the global optimum of receiving the most passengers using the least number of SAVs.

articleTitle: Car accidents prediction based on cloud computing in data analysis
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: By using cloud computing and machine learning to analyze traffic accident data in the United States, this paper explores the practicability of cloud computing in data analysis and the possibility of using this model for traffic accident early warning. The experiment first stores the data in Hadoop File System and reads it out as Spark dataframe, and then uses Spark SQL for preliminary analysis and preprocessing. Then, traffic accident predictions are made using four machine learning algorithms in Spark MLlib. After comparing with the original data, logistic regression, random forest, and Gradient Boosted Trees all performed well, and the accuracy rate can reach more than 78% although the data itself is biased slightly, confirming that this model can be used to predict traffic accidents.

articleTitle: Research on multi-interface conversion design technology based on network
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: A multi-interface conversion design technique based on network is proposed to meet the increasing rapid development of weaponry and equipment. Firstly, the highly-density multi-interface of the telematics unit is analyzed based on the unified architecture of the network interface; Secondly, the online configuration and reconfiguration of the interface are designed from the four aspects of online reconfiguration resource unified management, fast link reconstruction, state detection and interface multiplexing. Finally, a unified conversion protocol model is introduced to complete data extraction, parsing, reconstruction and forwarding of each interface to realize one-way or two-way transmission of information. The results show that the designed multi-interface conversion design system can meet the needs of complex weapon equipment, and has reference significance for the transformation of weapon equipment to network-centric computing mode.

articleTitle: Modeling and optimization of CO2 pipeline transportation system
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: CO2 capture, transportation, oil displacement and storage (CCUS) technology is considered to be one of the most effective ways to reduce carbon emissions. It can not only store a large amount of CO2, but also increase oil production. As the intermediate link of CCUS, the importance of CO2 transportation system is self-evident. In this paper, on the basis of establishing the engineering and economic model of CO2 pipeline transportation system, the optimization model of CO2 transportation system is constructed, and the optimization problem of CO2 pipeline transportation system based on genetic algorithm is proposed. The simulation results show the effectiveness of the algorithm. It provides some theoretical basis for the implementation of CO2 pipeline transportation system.

articleTitle: Short-term Portfolio Trading Strategy Based on Deep Learning and Simulated Annealing Algorithm Taking Bitcoin and Gold for Example
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: As the foundation of modern finance, portfolio theory was proposed by Harry Markowitz in 1952, with mean-variance analysis to determine the efficient frontier for a variety of tradable assets. However, Markowitz mainly relies on past statistical data to describe the impending changes of assets and to determine the optimal allocation of assets, making it difficult to capture price changes in time. Additionally, there are many limitations in Markowitz's theory, which makes it difficult for the theoretical optimal solution obtained by the model to be directly used in real-life trading scenarios. Based on this, this paper selects gold and bitcoin as two typical tradable assets, and uses LSTM to predict the prices of them. Then, according to the portfolio theory, two models that can be utilized for short-term trading are proposed. Finally, the simulated annealing algorithm is utilized to obtain the solutions of the two models respectively, and the optimal trading strategy is formulated.

articleTitle: Construction of target importance evaluation index system based on complex network
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The application of network information technology makes the interaction relationship between various equipment show the characteristics of complex network. Using the relevant theoretical knowledge of complex network to describe the interaction relationship between nodes can intuitively reflect the importance of each node. By abstracting each device as a node in a complex network, the function relationship between each node is abstracted as a link between nodes. Different evaluation indicators lead to different weights of each connected edge, which will affect the importance of the node. Building a target importance evaluation index system is the basis for evaluating the importance of target nodes using complex networks.

articleTitle: Literature review on human-computer interaction research in marketing field under the background of big data: A bibliometric research through CiteSpace
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Purpose: From the perspective of academic literature, this research analyzes and summarizes the research of human-computer interaction in the field of marketing. Through the analysis of the current development situation, we put forward suggestions for future academic research. Methodology: This research obtains relevant foreign literature from the Web of Science, uses scientific bibliometric methods through CiteSpace software to make analysis on the number of papers, authors, publishing journals and institutions, and puts forward the future development trend of human-computer interaction in the field of marketing through keyword co-occurrence analysis and cluster analysis. Finding: Through literature review, this research found that after 2019, relevant research has shown a rapid growth trend in recent years. Through keyword co-occurrence and cluster analysis, it shows that the research of human-computer interaction depends on the development of electronic information technology, and combined with users' personality differences and different perception, has become the key points of human-computer integration research. Intelligent immersive technology, anthropomorphic features of service robots, and diversification of interaction scenes will also become an important development direction of human-computer interaction research in the field of marketing in the future.

articleTitle: The Optimization of Magnetic Coupling Mechanism and Circuit Parameters for Long-distance Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Based on the principle of magnetic field resonance coupling, the wireless power transfer over a long distance can be realized from transmitters to receivers. For the entire magnetic coupling resonant wireless power transfer system, the coupling strength between the coils restricts the transfer distance with high efficiency. The main restriction factor of the coupling coefficient is the coil parameters. However, in engineering practice, the size and weight of the magnetic coupler are limited due to environment and cost limitations. To analyze the transfer characteristics of the system, firstly, the equivalent model of the system is established by using the mutual inductance equivalent theory, and the relationship among electrical parameters is researched. Secondly, based on the finite element simulation platform, we consider the influence of the number of coil turns on the self-inductance and coupling coefficient under a certain transfer distance of 150mm and coupler size constraints. And we analyze the variation trend of the output power and transfer efficiency. Finally, by building a simulation verification platform, the transfer efficiency of the designed system is as high as 91%, which verifies the efficiency and feasibility of the designed magnetic coupling mechanism.

articleTitle: Overview of camera detection and laser scanning detection technology for subway tunnel structural diseases
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Subway plays a great role in urban public transportation because of its advantages of large capacity, fast and energy saving. Under the influence of the constant change of service environment and the gradual degradation of material performance, the damage caused by the degradation of subway tunnel structure performance is becoming increasingly prominent. The healthy service of subway tunnel is facing severe challenges, which directly affects the operation efficiency and public transport safety of Metro. How to complete a large number of detection work in a limited time has become the focus of the development of detection technology. In this context, the efficient and fast camera measurement and laser scanning measurement technology have become an important direction of the development of tunnel rapid detection technology. This paper will introduce the current research status of traditional detection methods, camera detection technology and laser scanning detection technology for typical structural diseases of tunnel environment, and summarize and prospect the rapid disease detection technology.

articleTitle: The Behavior of Access Mode Choices for Rail Stations Based on Multiple Logit Model
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In economically developed cities, urban rail transit is the backbone of the whole urban transportation system. If the relationship between rail transit and other transportation connection modes can be coordinated, it will not only shorten people's travel time and improve travel comfort, but also expand the service scope of urban rail transit and finally optimize the travel structure of urban residents. In order to improve the efficiency of urban rail transit station connection, this paper takes Xiamen rail transit as the research background, based on multiple logit models, uses RP survey method to design questionnaire, considers the personal attributes and travel attributes of rail transit travelers, establishes Xiamen rail transit station connection mode selection model, and uses SPSS 23.0 to calibrate and test the parameters, Finally, the sharing rate of each connection mode is obtained by the method of characteristic aggregation. The research results can provide a basis for studying the connection behavior mechanism of urban rail transit stations, reasonably planning the layout of rail transit connection facilities, and improving the travel efficiency of urban rail transit. It has urgent theoretical and practical significance for optimizing urban traffic structure and rail connection resource allocation.

articleTitle: Quality assessment and improvement of radar fault cause text
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Text quality directly affects the effect of text analysis. On the basis of summarizing the problems that exist in the radar fault cause, the text quality assessment and improvement method based on the knowledge graph searching is proposed. First, assessment index system of text quality of radar fault causes was constructed, and DAHP method was applied to weight each index. Then, classification scoring rules were set by the method of knowledge graph searching. Finally, the quality of the historical low quality fault cause text is improved and the quality of new entry text is guaranteed. The examples show that the text assessment method based on the knowledge graph searching is more suitable for radar fault cause texts. The quality of the historical text is effectively promoted, and the quality of the newly entered text is effectively guaranteed. It lays the foundation for intelligent analysis of equipment indemnification texts.

articleTitle: Design of Subway Spatial Guidance Interactive System for Visually Impaired People Based on Customer Journey Map and Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: As a special group in social life, the visually impaired face many practical problems when taking the subway. Based on the CJM method, this paper evaluates and analyzes the subway travel of visually impaired people from the perspective of location, behavior and opportunity points. The AHP method is used to score the optimization schemes at different levels of the subway spatial guidance interaction system for the visually impaired. The corresponding score set and matrix set are formed to compute the relevant evaluation result vectors, and then the optimal design direction is obtained to optimize the subway spatial guidance interaction system oriented to the visually impaired. It also provides concepts and references for the study of visually impaired people's travel in subways and other public spaces.

articleTitle: Aircraft Traffic Visualization System for Airline Companies
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The paper is focused on the area of data visualization to design one aircraft traffic visualization system. There are visual mapping and navigation in this web app. The technique for the map in this system is OpenLayers. It is an open source JavaScript library for displaying map data in the web browsers. This map can display navigation with arrow buttons. It can display the airlines between two places and the price. The database used in this project is MongoDB. It is an opensource cross-platform document-oriented database program. The system will be provided a clear display for the airline companies to see all the information about the airplanes among the serval destinations and will also help the future airline planning.

articleTitle: Construction of hospital big data center for intelligent medical care
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: New technologies of Internet of Things and artificial intelligence are rapidly developing in the field of medical big health, and they are widely used in many fields such as text analysis of medical records, image recognition, and analysis of medical procedures. The construction of hospital big data center can give full play to the potential value of medical big data and realize the effective interaction among patients, medical care and treatment institutions through big data mining. By analyzing the classification, composition, characteristics and application scenarios of medical big data, adapting different storage and computing schemes and building hospital big data center according to the scheme, supporting the unified storage management of data resources, realizing the classification application, rapid retrieval, sharing and exchange and intelligent computing of data in different medical fields, maximizing the utilization of medical service resources, taking the construction of the eastern war zone general hospital big data as a typical case. It also promotes the scientific, professional, digital and refinement of hospital operation and management.

articleTitle: A Tactical Decision-making Method for Short Track Speed Skating based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Short track speed skating is a sport that has attracted much attention at the Winter Olympics. In addition to athlete's physical level and physiological state, competition performance is more easily affected by athlete's tactical level. An athlete with excellent tactical decision-making ability tends to have better skating performance. Traditional methods mainly use decision trees and genetic algorithms to learn tactical strategies. However, these methods often require complex rule design, and the learned tactical strategies are limited by training data and are not always effective. Therefore, we propose a novel tactical decision-making method for short track speed skating based on deep reinforcement learning. Specifically, we build a short track speed skating simulation competition environment through detailed analysis and research. Further, we adopt the deep reinforcement learning algorithm to learn and explore the agent's tactical strategy. In addition, we design a state representation network to effectively model the state features of the agent. Based on real short-track speed skating competition data, we used agents instead of athletes to conduct competitions in the simulation environment. Tactical strategies learned by the agent can significantly improve competition performance. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Characteristic Analysis of Curved CWR based on matlab
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to meet the demand of high-quality train operation and reduce the maintenance workload, the whole section of Qinghai-Tibet Railway in Gela section was completed in 2012-2017. Among them, 550km of jointless track was laid in permafrost regions, and it was found that the overall operation of the track was in good condition during on-site operation, but the problem of uneven settlement of subgrade in permafrost subgrade sections still existed. Uneven settlement of subgrade will lead to irregularity of track surface, variation of ballast bed parameters, and high ballast bed in some sections. Under the influence of temperature change, a large rail displacement occurs. In this paper, combined with the problems of the thickness change and temperature change of CWR track bed in the frost heaving section of Qinghai-Tibet railway subgrade, the nonlinear finite element numerical analysis model program of track frame is compiled by matlab program, and the displacement change of CWR long rail under the conditions of roadbed thickness and temperature change is studied by combining with field and laboratory tests.

articleTitle: Evaluating online Car-Hailing Quality of Service Based on the Entropy and IPA method
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Maintaining high quality of service is the core competitiveness of major online car-hailing platforms and the foundation of the benign development of online car-hailing industry. From the perspective of customer satisfaction, the service quality of online car-hailing is evaluated. Firstly, according to the adjustment of the SERVQUAL scale based on the characteristics of online car-hailing service, an evaluation index system with 5 first-level indexes and 19 second-level indexes is established. Secondly, data are collected in the form of questionnaires, then AHP and entropy method are combined to calculate the comprehensive weights. Finally, Taking Dazhou city in Sichuan Province as an example of empirical research, IPA analysis method is used to combine the index weights and user perception of service quality and IPA matrix for each index weight and user satisfaction is also drawn. The goal is to determine the priority of optimization of influencing factors of online car-hailing service quality and provide effective basis for online car-hailing enterprises to improve service quality.

articleTitle: Vehicle trajectory prediction through manual setting and machine learning
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The prediction of vehicle trajectory is an important step in safe driving. The relative positions or speeds of vehicles affect the interactions between them, which in turn produce predictions of trajectories. Through the trajectory prediction of each vehicle to form a complete safe driving environment. This paper will be divided into two parts for vehicle track, namely manual setting and machine learning. The advantage of manual setting is that it is convenient to observe the characteristics and then make other vehicles follow the corresponding behaviour. However, the disadvantage is that the characteristics that can be observed are incomplete, which makes the experimental error relatively large. The advantage of machine learning is that through previous experience to make all vehicles change in the corresponding situation. Through previous experience to make all vehicles change in the corresponding situation. An effective extraction and addition of the original data is helpful to reduce the final error.

articleTitle: Combination weighted TOPSIS based Evaluation model construction of semi-physical virtual training System
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The evaluation problem of semi-physical virtual training system is important. the demand of the architecture of the virtual training system and its functions are analysed, and an evaluation system contained price, accuracy, reliability, maintainability, safety, and usability is established. AHP and EWM combination weighting method is used to get the weight of each index matrix. The candidate products are evaluated by TOPSIS, and the results obtained by this method are consistent with the expert-experience method according to the actual case calculation.

articleTitle: Development of semiconductor communication software device based on SECS/GEM protocol
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The complexity of semiconductor production process and the wide variety of semiconductor production equipment, and there is no unified communication standard between the equipment, which seriously limits the development of semiconductor factory production automation. Facing this situation, this paper proposes a method of developing semiconductor communication software based on SECS/GEM protocol. This paper introduces the basic content of SECS/GEM communication protocol, integrates and analyzes the state model of each layer of the protocol, designs and implements the communication software according to the actual situation in factory production, tests the communication software, verifies that the software meets the basic functions defined by SECS/GEM, carries out relevant message transmission and performance comparison, and proves the superiority of the communication software.

articleTitle: Cyclist head injuries Based on an electric bicycle to car accident reconstruction
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Electric bike cyclists are more vulnerable in urban road traffic. The effects of vehicle speed and electric bike speed on the craniocerebral injury of cyclists should be studied. First, the main forms and causes of craniocerebral injury were sorted out in this paper, and the current applicable evaluation criteria for head injury were summarized. Then, MADYMO software was used to reconstruct a real case of electric bike-vehicle collision. The simulation conditions of MADYMO were set by parameters such as collision speed, collision position and acceleration to reproduce the motion response process of each participant after the collision between the vehicle and the electric bike and the cyclist, and the reliability of the simulation model and the feasibility of the simulation test method are verified by comparing with the accident site. Based on verifying the feasibility of the model, two factors affecting the craniocerebral injury of cyclists were studied based on the model: vehicle collision speed and electric bike speed. Through the control variable method, a certain speed of electric bike was selected, and three groups of vehicle speeds were set to study the impact of vehicle collision speed on the brain of cyclists. Select a certain vehicle speed and set two groups of electric bike speed to study the influence of electric bike speed on the brain of cyclists. Finally, the simulation results were analyzed: the peak head acceleration and HIC value under different experimental conditions were obtained from the simulation experiment scheme, and the influence of vehicle speed and electric two-wheeled vehicle speed on the head injury of cyclists was analyzed.

articleTitle: A research on the open-water performance of an amphibious vehicle propeller based on CFD
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The water speed of an amphibious vehicle is determined by the vehicle body resistance, propulsion device input power and propulsion efficiency, and the propulsion efficiency of the water propulsion device is a key factor in the water performance of the vehicle. This paper analyses the performance of the propeller of an amphibious vehicle, and analyses the parameters such as thrust, torque and open water efficiency of the propeller when it works in open water by CFD method, and compares them with the test results, and finds that the conclusions are in good agreement with the theoretical analysis results, so as to form a preliminary propeller open water performance prediction method and provide reference for the subsequent design work.

articleTitle: Urban Covid-19 Analysis and Prediction Based on Machine Learning and LSTM Models
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: To find out the urban factors affecting the development of the epidemic and to predict the epidemic more accurately and quickly, a series of experiments were conducted by machine learning model and Long Shot-Term Memory (LSTM) model. The most important features were first identified by the k-means clustering model and then the "epidemic development indicator" features were determined by the principal component analysis (PCA) model. The experiments show that this "epidemic development indicator" feature can reduce the amount of data while successfully classifying epidemic devel-opment in cities. To analyze the contribution of city data to epidemic development, a decision tree method was used to analyze and visualize the results. The results showed that the most important factor was population size, followed by population density and latitude, and the least influential factor was the annual temperature. To predict and respond to the epidemic more quickly and accurately, a Term Memory (LSTM) model was introduced and a low error was achieved.

articleTitle: Random walk simulation on the silver price for the first 20 years in the 21st Century
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Simulation is one of most powerful tools in computational era. It not only gives us full pictures on the issues of interest but also allows us to predict what will become the issue of interest in the future. The big data collected in financial markets with modern digital technologies provide unlimited opportunities to simulate the performance of any stock and commodity under different circumstances. Simulation is actually based upon its underlined models, and thus different models generate different simulations against their targeted behaviour. Silver is an important commodity, and its price is closely followed by investment banks, hedge funds, investors and research institutes and is subject to various simulations based upon different models. The random walk model can simulate the natural phenomena with a few model parameters to account for unexplainable influencing factors. In this study, we apply the random walk model to simulate the silver price for the first 20 years in the 21st century. The results show that the random walk simulation can simulate the silver price for five different segments of time. Thus, the current study provides the further evidence to support the efficient market hypothesis.

articleTitle: Navigation safety evaluation of waterway based on AHP-EW grey fuzzy synthesis
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: To ensure the navigation safety of the channel, a safety evaluation model based on hierarchy entropy weight grey fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is proposed, which is verified by taking Dagusha channel of Tianjin Port as an example. Firstly, the factors affecting the navigation safety of the channel are divided into four first-class indicators, nine second-class indicators and 23 third-class indicators, so as to establish the evaluation index system of navigation safety of the channel; Secondly, analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and entropy weight method (EW) are used to determine the subjective and objective weights of each index respectively, and the two are multiplied and normalized to obtain the combined weight of the index; Finally, the grey fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is used to evaluate the safety of port channel navigation. Taking Dagusha channel of Tianjin Port as an example, the safety of Dagusha channel is evaluated by using the grey fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model of hierarchy entropy weight, and then compared with the traditional fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model to verify the evaluation results. The results show that the model has good applicability and accuracy when applied to channel navigation safety evaluation. At the same time, it also provides some reference suggestions for maritime supervision and other relevant departments to ensure ship navigation safety.

articleTitle: Study on Water Ecological Carrying Capacity Model of Qin-Mang River Basin (Henan Section) based on SD and Cloud Model
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In this study, based on the basic data of Qin-Mang River Basin (Henan section) and the evaluation results of the original ‘DPRSR’ water ecological carrying capacity evaluation model, the SD model and cloud model of system dynamics were constructed combined with the development status of Qin-Mang River Basin (Henan section), and the effectiveness of the model was tested using the Vensim PLE software and Python software. The results show that the constructed SD model has passed the validity test and is reliable, so the constructed model can be used for the water ecological carrying capacity of Qin-Mang River Basin and has strong consistency with the calculation results of the original ‘DPRSR’ water ecological carrying capacity evaluation model.

articleTitle: User equilibrium assignment with expected utility theory
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: This paper proposes an improved user equilibrium traffic assignment method with utility theory. The traditional user equilibrium traffic assignment uses the minimizing travel time of users as the goal which is called Wardrop equilibrium criterion. Unlike the classical model, this paper assumes that the link travel time is a random variable and the user considers the risk of uncertainty. Then this paper uses the expected utility function to describe the user’s decision-making problem, and constructs a new equilibrium criterion and model. Subsequently, this paper gives the algorithm and example. The result shows that the new equilibrium criterion can more accurately describe the path selection behaviour of users.

articleTitle: Network security experiment simulation platform based on CTSL
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Network security experiment simulation platform is an important supporting platform for training network security talents. In the traditional network security experiment platform, the network experiment scene is usually realized by static pre configuration. Personnel training can only be carried out according to the designed script specification, which can not meet the needs of diversified and practical simulation scenes in training. In this paper, we propose a domain specific language named CSTL (cybersecurity training scenario language) for network security experiment scenarios, and we build a network security experiment simulation platform on the open source cloud platform openstack, which provides a new development idea for the field of network simulation.

articleTitle: Automated Analysis of Differences in the Functionality and Performance of 3D CAD Systems for Collaborative Design
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: 3D CAD systems are widely applied in collaborative design, but different 3D CAD systems may have differences when performing the same functionality, which may cause potential errors in subsequent manufacturing and processing. This paper proposes an automated analysis method to determine differences in the functionality and performance of different 3D CAD systems based on a uniform interface. A hierarchical comparison method is proposed to automatically analyse the differences between the 3D CAD models generated by different 3D CAD systems in the same testing program, based on which the differences in the functionality of these 3D CAD systems can be analysed. The performance data of different 3D CAD systems are also recorded and compared. In the end, three 3D CAD systems are tested and analysed to demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Slow-Moving Target Detection of SAR images using High-IOU Sub-Aperture Decomposition
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: To tackle the challenge for the detection of slow-moving targets in single channel SAR images, a new method is proposed to improve the detection performance and to estimates the radial velocity by using the High Intersection-over-Union Sub-aperture Decomposition (HISAD) method. Firstly, the Along Track Interferometry SAR (SAR-ATI) system is given by modelling the working modes of binary channels. Then the concept of equivalent interference baseline is proposed, and the linear relationship between synthetic aperture time and frequency of radar signal is used to align the sub-aperture images generated by the HISAD method. The feasibility of this method was validated by comparing the equivalent ATI results of the HISAD method with the real results of the two-channel. Finally, the Magnitude and Phase Constant False Alarm Rate (M&P-CFAR) detector was constructed, and its threshold expression was derived to successfully separate the slow-moving target from the clutter background. The results show that the new method effectively detect slow-moving targets from single-channel SAR images which covered with clutter, and reasonably estimate their radial velocity.

articleTitle: Research on forecast of battery electric vehicle’s ownership in seven regions of China based on BASS diffusion model
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The vigorous development of electric vehicle industry is of great significance to the macro-adjustment of automobile industry structure, the promotion of carbon emission reduction in the transportation field and the consumption of new energy power. This paper adopts the battery electric vehicle data of traffic administration, for the Northeast, the Northwest, the Southwest, the Central, the North, the South, the East, which are seven administrative geographical areas of China, to build regional battery electric vehicle’s ownership model based on BASS diffusion model, and produce the regional parameter fitting results, curve fitting results and ownership changes, respectively. After fitting the BASS model using a general fitting optimization algorithm without any given parameters, the results show that the growth curve of battery electric vehicles in each region is basically S-shaped, but the growth rate, growth threshold and inflection point in different regions are greatly different. With the development policy of electric vehicles basically unchanged, the number of battery electric vehicles in China will reach 18.5 million in 2030, among which the number of that in East China and South China will reach the peak, while the number in Northeast China and North China is still in the initial stage of growth.

articleTitle: Research and design of water hardness on-line detection system
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low automation and inconvenient data recording of traditional water quality hardness detection, this paper proposes a water quality hardness determination method based on image technology. Based on EDTA complexometric titration reaction, an on-line water quality hardness monitoring system mainly controlled by GD32F307 microprocessor is designed and developed, which can realize the automatic on-line monitoring of water quality hardness. The detection range is 0 ~ 10mg / L (CaCO3), and the relative error is ≤± 5%, Relative standard deviation ≤ 2%; The detection system has RS-485 communication function and can upload data to the upper computer. The self-developed software on the upper computer has the functions of storage, management, generating measurement curve, generating test report according to the established standard and so on. The system has been put into practical use in a factory. The use for a period of time proves that the system achieves the expected design goal and provides new technical support for water hardness testing.

articleTitle: Numerical modeling of ELF / VLF radiation source generated by heating the low ionosphere
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Using powerful high-frequency (HF) radio waves to modulate the heating of the low ionosphere region can make the natural current in the ionosphere oscillate and radiate ELF/VLF waves. Starting from the electron energy equation, this paper simulates the process of heating the ionosphere and analyzes the effect of different modulation frequencies on the heating of the ionosphere and the generation of dipole moment. The results show that the electron temperature has an equilibrium state in the process of heating and cooling. The lower the modulation frequency is, the better the equilibrium state can be reached. At this time, the maximum dipole moment of the ELF/VLF radiation source is 7.3×10(exp 4)A⋅m.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation indicators of military intelligence recommendation systems
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The military intelligence recommendation systems provide personalized content and services to all levels and types of intelligence users by processing a large number of dynamically generated military intelligence, and effectively alleviates the problem of information overload. The evaluation indicator system is an important basis for testing and optimization. This paper focuses on the evaluation indicators of the military intelligence recommendation systems, summarizes the general process of indicators construction, introduces the characteristics and quantitative methods of each indicator, tests and demonstrates the effectiveness of the indicator system, and puts forward the next research direction. The indicator system construction method described in this paper can provide guidance for the comprehensive evaluation and optimization of relevant systems.

articleTitle: Research on Autonomous Emergency Braking Pedestrain Test of China New Car Assessment Program
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: As an important part of vulnerable road users, pedestrians have great flexibility and mobility in participating in traffic activities, and pedestrian traffic accidents are one of the most frequent traffic accidents nowadays. To reduce pedestrianrelated traffic accidents. The China New Car Assessment Programme Management Regulation(C-NCAP) introduced pedestrian test evaluation scenarios in the 2018 edition, and the scenarios were optimized and tightened in the 2021 edition. This paper introduces the study of pedestrian test evaluation scenarios from the perspective of traffic accidents, and it finally summarized two typical test scenarios which include car to crossing pedestrain and car to longitudinal pedestrain.

articleTitle: Influencing factors of college students' travel behaviour based on data analysis
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The rapid advancement of the Internet has led to the rapid development of a new industry, the online car industry. The rise of car-hailing industry has a profound impact on the survival and development of traditional transport modes, and at the same time, it makes travellers' choice of modes of travel more complicated. As a leading group in the experimental phase of a new industry, the college students have a distinctive life pattern and travel characteristics. Therefore, it is particularly important to deeply explore the factors that influence the choice of college students' travel modes under the background of online car-sharing. This paper conducts a random survey on the travel behaviour of the college students in Dalian based on a combined SP/RP survey method and analyses the relevant data statistically. By integrating Structural Equation Model (SEM) and Multinomial Logit (MNL), a SEM-MNL travel mode discrete choice model is established, which integrates traditional factors such as personal characteristics, travel characteristics and attitude perception factors, and determines the travel mode choice model of college students through model parameter estimation and testing. On this basis, the factors affecting the travel mode choice of college students are rationalized and analysed.

articleTitle: Space obstacle detection based on passive source acoustic wave
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Space obstacle detection is important in avoiding obstacles for blind people and automatic driving. The passive source acoustic wave or ambient noise will reflect when there are obstacles and is received by detectors. Using cross-correlation, the passive signal can be synthetized as active source gather that is like the one in seismic prospecting. Finally, the synthetized gather can be imaging according to the depth pre-stack migration, and the space obstacle can be detected. Both theoretical data and experimental data tested the method effectively.

articleTitle: The Influence of Cao'e River Sluice Operation on Mashan River Water Flow Flood Control Based on Two-dimensional Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Flood control and dredging has always been the most important task of water conservancy projects. Shaoxing plain has many water systems and complicated rivers, which have the potential risk of disasters. It is necessary to control the water level of the river network through gate regulation. Cao'e River sluice plays a key role in Shaoxing river network. Finding out the best opening time of flood discharge sluice can not only ensure the life and property safety of the surrounding people, but also minimize the impact of gate operation on the surrounding environment. This paper studies the flow characteristics of Mashan River in the river network by establishing a two-dimensional mathematical model of the river network, and uses Mike software to simulate and analyze it. It is concluded that the best time to open the Cao'e River Sluice 17 hours before the rainstorm.

articleTitle: Analysis on the functions and requirements of shore power equipment management and energy efficiency system construction
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The use of shore power is the most effective means to solve the pollution during ship berthing. The use of shore power management and energy efficiency system can improve the use efficiency of shore power. This paper analyzes the construction requirements of shore power system in detail, analyzes the technical requirements and performance requirements of shore power system, and strengthens the equipment operation management on the basis of scientific statistics of energy consumption data, so as to improve the use efficiency of shore power, so as to improve the proportion of clean energy in the port.

articleTitle: Optimized application of GIS and CGA in transportation path planning of open-pit mines
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: paper comprehensively considers the factors such as road elevation, road slope, road quality and truck driving speed, combines dynamic time-varying transport power with static transport distance, and establishes a truck transportation path planning model for open-pit mines. Firstly, ArcGIS software is used as the geographic information collection and analysis platform for open-pit mine path selection. Then, the cellular genetic algorithm (CGA) is used to solve the problem when the loading point and unloading point are known, and the invisible migration mechanism is introduced in the genetic algorithm. Finally, a large limestone mine in Wuhan is taken as an example to verify the algorithm. The results show that compared with the traditional genetic algorithm, the cellular genetic algorithm has better global optimization ability and better transportation path, which verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the cellular genetic algorithm for solving the transportation path problem of open-pit mines.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Survivability Mechanism of Multi-domain Optical Backbone Network Based on VPI
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The survivability mechanism in the multi-domain backbone optical network has always been a key issue that we need to consider because it is related to information loss. Design 1+1 protection, 1:1 protection, 1: N (N=2) link-level protection schemes, rely on the VPI simulation platform, and analyze the results through the simulation of multi-domain optical network construction. It is concluded that the 1+1 protection scheme has almost no delay, but the 1: N (N=2) protection scheme is better than the other two in protection efficiency, and the protection scheme is extended on the basis of the ring network. One-way path loop protection and two-way path loop protection schemes are designed and simulated on the VPI simulation platform.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Digital Marketing System Based on Web Technology
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The current market economy is developing and prosperous, and the consumer market has always followed the rule of survival of the fittest. How to formulate precise marketing strategies to market their own products has become a key issue for enterprise managers to consider. If you want to do a good job in marketing, you must first understand the needs of customers, accurately position the product in the market, and find the consumer market suitable for your own products, so as to complete the marketing service in a targeted manner. Although there are many marketing strategies of various enterprises, most of them are only to explore one kind of consumer group or one sales direction, and there is no relatively complete marketing system structure. The development and design of the system in this paper is aimed at the emerging marketing method-digital marketing. Using B/S architecture, based on Java web technology combined with SSH architecture and big data Hadoop ecological cluster technology and database technology, we have developed a market analysis data that can help enterprise managers understand a full range of data, and formulate marketing strategies based on the obtained data to achieve Digital marketing system for precision marketing purposes. By analyzing and integrating data such as the consumption level, feedback and internal sales of different consumers in the market, the problem of precision marketing of the company's products and the adjustment of the company's internal marketing structure is solved, and the effect of providing personalized services to consumers is achieved. It has achieved the purpose of improving the competitive advantage of the enterprise and successfully marketing the product.

articleTitle: Research on aerospace information supporting anti-missile operation process and effectiveness evaluation method
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Anti-missile operation is an important military operation related to the survival of troops, and aerospace information plays a huge role in supporting anti-missile operations. This paper analyses the specific process of anti-missile operations under the support of aerospace information, establishes the operation model, selects indicators, and builds an aerospace information system effectiveness evaluation system, and uses the house of quality method to evaluate the effectiveness of aerospace information support. The research results have certain reference significance for the operational application of aerospace resources and the optimization of anti-missile combat process.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Distribution Network Operating Analysis Platform Based on Multi-source Heterogeneous Data
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Big data technology is an effective way to mine the value of massive data on distribution and consumption, which can significantly improve the production, operation monitoring and control of distribution network. This paper presents a method to establish a distribution network operating analysis platform. Based on analysis of source and type of big data in smart power distribution and consumption systems, functional requirements are proposed, such as evaluation of distribution network scare, power distribution reliability, equipment running state and so on. In application, system structure is proposed which including levels of business, application, data center and data base. By means of big data processing and visualization technology, platform shows the whole picture of distribution operating through integrating basic information such as power system, equipment, circumstance, and big data analysis results. And it also develops some advanced applications such as fault analysis.

articleTitle: Covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy based on multidistribution collaborative sampling
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In the power system, multiple heuristic optimization algorithms optimize the economic dispatch (ED) of multiple fuel options, but they all have the disadvantage of low convergence accuracy. This paper proposes an covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy based on multi-distribution collaborative sampling (MD-CMA-ES) to solve the large-scale ED problem. Multi-distribution cooperative sampling uses the accuracy of normal distribution and the breadth sampling of uniform distribution to improve sample diversity and prevent falling into the local optimum. The method is validated on 2 test systems consisting of 10 and 40 generator sets and compared with other algorithms, and the experimental results show that the method can obtain better solutions.

articleTitle: Using traffic restriction scheme to encourage carsharing
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: For the purpose of encouraging carsharing and thereby improving traffic system, we propose a scheme that carsharing vehicles are allowed to enter the traffic restriction district while the solo-driving vehicles are forbidden. A varational inequality is built to describe the travelers’ mode and route choice following Logit mode split and the user equilibrium principle and applied to a numerical example to detect the performance of the simple network. Then we use a bi-level programming to design the optimal restriction area and the proportion. The results show that this scheme is effective in increasing social welfare, and the optimal area and proportion exist. The social welfare is not always higher along with the higher amortize cost of owning a vehicle and the carsharing demand due to the elastic demand.

articleTitle: Global path planning for intelligent ships based on energy consumption optimization
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
