abstract: In this paper, aiming at the problem that the path with the least energy consumption is often not in the traditional path planning with the constraint conditions of path distance and path smoothness, an improved A* algorithm global path planning with the constraint condition of energy consumption is proposed. By analyzing the resistance model of ships in ocean current environment, the energy consumption function of intelligent ships is established, and an improved A* search algorithm for optimal energy consumption is proposed, and the algorithm is simulated under different ocean current states. Simulation results show that this algorithm can save energy compared with the traditional distance optimization algorithm, and obtain a more economic and environmental protection path, and effectively improve the endurance of intelligent ships.

articleTitle: Numerical modelling of hyperpycnal flows in Yellow River Delta
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The impacts of suspended sediment concentration (SSC) and river discharges on the formation and evolution of the hyperpycnal flows in the Yellow River Estuary (YRE) were studied using a three-dimensional circulation-sediment model. The model is well-calibrated using the field data of tidal elevation, current velocity, salinity and suspended sediment concentration (SSC) in the YRE. Results show that high SSC (>30-35 kg/m3) is the crucial factor to the formation of hyperpycnal flows. It was because high SSC can overcome the density increase due to salinity in ambient water. During the periods of flood and ebb, hyperpycnal flows show periodic characteristics in the bottom layer. High river discharge is essential for maintaining hyperpycnal flows in the YRE. This study helps to understand the initiation and maintenance of hyperpycnal flows in estuaries.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a small diving safety detection underwater robot
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to test the safety of diving in shallow waters, this design uses a small submersible safety detection underwater robot based on STM32 microcontroller, which can be used as a small cable unmanned underwater robot (ROV, Remote Operated Vehicle) detected in shallow waters. The underwater robot can realize the self-balance of the underwater posture, detect the underwater environment, fuse the sensor data, and send the water detection results to the upper computer display through the wireless module. Brief introduction of hardware structure design, software framework construction, introduce the control algorithm, sensor data collection and diving water hazard judgment. The underwater robot has verified the feasibility and stability of this design.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor fusion positioning
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In recent years, intelligent driving industry booming, accurate positioning in the intelligent driving is particularly important for automatic parking vehicle positioning inaccurate problem in the process, is proposed based on the multisensor fusion positioning method of ultrasonic and visual, according to the ultrasonic and visual sensor provides real-time information, application of extended kalman filter in combination with weighted fusion method, Update vehicle location information during parking. Simulation and test results show that the proposed fusion location method can provide more accurate real-time vehicle location and more accurate location information for planning and control.

articleTitle: Fusion Convolution Hyperspectral Image Classification Based on Parallel Attention Strategy
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: For hyperspectral image classification, traditional 3D convolution can obtain spatial information without losing spectral dimension information. Therefore, hyperspectral classification model based on 3D convolution usually has high classification accuracy. However, 3D convolution models are usually complex and consume a lot of computing resources. In order to reduce the complexity of network structure of traditional convolution based on 3D convolution, this paper proposes a fusion convolution hyperspectral image classification model based on parallel attention strategy. The model uses 3D and 2D convolution to learn spectral-spatial information at the same time, and effectively improves the classification accuracy of the model through parallel attention strategy. Experiments on two real data sets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed model.

articleTitle: Multi-Network Task Offloading with Improved Recording Neural Network
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: For the current development of edge computing, it has become a new trend for multiple wireless devices to form a network to connect to the entire system. At the same time, task offloading in this scenario is partially different from traditional edge computing. For multiple systems, how to efficiently allocate tasks has become the primary problem that needs to be solved in this scenario. This paper proposes an improved task offloading algorithm based on neural network. By using neural network to learn the process of task offloading, and at the same time calculate the cost after each decision, the decision that makes the cost decreasing will be recorded, the decision with the original task size is used as the input of the neural network together. Experiments show that the trained neural network can quickly and efficiently obtain the offloading result after each task input while ensuring the lowest delay and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Design of automatic recognition of modern Chinese metaphor types based on artificial intelligence technology
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Deep learning technology has been widely used in the field of artificial intelligence, great progress has been made in machine translation and man-machine dialogue. But there are still many problems in artificial intelligence’s “language understanding” of natural language, such as the recognition and translation of rhetoric in natural language, which is still a big problem. This paper combines linguistics with deep learning technology, we propose an approach to compare and recognize the different types of modern Chinese metaphor through using of the experimental design, according to data sampling method, and the experimental data model of CNN, RNN, Transform, Fast Text, Bert base. The study found that according to the characteristics of modern Chinese metaphor, the design is suitable and available for automatic recognition of metaphorical sentence types in modern Chinese, and the Bert base has the highest accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles in the Field of Maritime Safety
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: With the advantages of small size, high flexibility and high safety factor, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have been widely used in the field of maritime safety in various countries. In this paper, based on the mind map model, the application of domestic and foreign UAVs in the field of maritime safety is studied, and the innovative research on the application of UAVs tilt photography technology, UAVs Lidar technology and UAVs gas emission monitoring technology in the field of maritime safety is carried out.

articleTitle: Encrypted Network Traffic Classification Method Based on Deep Capsule Network
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: With the increase of users' privacy awareness and the rapid development of network traffic encryption technology, encrypted traffic identification becomes a key task to maintain the security of cyberspace. In this paper, we propose a deep capsule network (DeepCapNet) based encrypted traffic classification method, which replaces the traditional dynamic routing algorithm with a three-dimensional convolutional routing algorithm to build a deep network, reduce the time complexity of the model, enhance the extraction of deep features of network traffic, and improve the classification accuracy. It improves the accuracy of classification. The model introduces a residual capsule layer to effectively solve the gradient disappearance problem of the deep neural network model. Experimental results on the ISCXVPN2016 dataset show that DeepCapNet outperforms existing encrypted traffic classification methods in terms of accuracy and has higher stability when dealing with small datasets.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Transport Knowledge Search Engine Based on ElasticSearch
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: According to the types and characteristics of science and technology information in the field of transportation, combined with the needs of the transportation knowledge service system for its retrieval, a transport knowledge search engine is developed. The engine is based on ElasticSearch, combined with the thesaurus in the field of transportation, plugged in the IKAnalyzer, and improved the search relevance sorting algorithm based on Okapi BM25. The engine provides three functions of data import, data indexing and data retrieval, and supports the transportation knowledge service system to realize one-stop retrieval of all kinds of integrated information. After testing, the search accuracy and performance of the engine can meet the requirements of use.

articleTitle: Monitoring and prediction of forest carbon sequestration: an example from Daxing'an Mountains, China
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: As the greenhouse effect intensifies, the role of forest carbon sequestration becomes ever more important. The scientific and accurate monitoring of forest carbon sequestration and the trend of carbon sequestration in the future period under certain management modes is worth studying. In this paper, we construct a carbon sequestration model VFP based on MODIS data and the GLO-PEM model to monitor the annual forest carbon sequestration in real-time. The parameters of the forest management plan are introduced to predict the future trend of forest carbon sequestration under a certified management mode. The simulation was carried out with the data of 2021 in the Daxing'an Mountains as an example. The results demonstrate that: The amount of carbon sequestration in that year is 2310.97 tons. The comprehensive benefit of the forest reaches the maximum when the initial harvesting age is 41 years, the harvesting intensity is 0.9 and the harvesting interval is 12 years. The amount of carbon sequestration in the area in the next 100 years is cyclical, and the cumulative amount of carbon sequestration in 100 years is 285644.47 tons.

articleTitle: The hydrodynamics of artificial reefs on the seabed of sediment with SPH
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The upwelling and eddy currents generated by artificial reefs can enhance minerals and nutrients to attract fish for resting, feeding and breeding. The stability of artificial reefs is an important guarantee for its flow field effect. In this paper, numerical simulations are conducted to study the fluid-structure interaction between artificial reefs and the flow as well as the sediment and mud on the seabed. The motion, overturning and sinking process of artificial reefs are obtained. The numerical results show that the muddy seabed increases the instability of artificial reefs. With the artificial reefs overturning and sinking, the volume of upwelling and wake vortex decreases, resulting a weak upward water transport capacity and wake effect. The weak water transport and wake will affect its function and efficiency directly.

articleTitle: RCS Data Management and Analysis System Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The establishment of non-cooperative targets requires 3D model establishment, RCS simulation, statistical characteristic analysis and consistency evaluation. The above work is generally carried out with different software, and the relevant algorithms are not standardized and encapsulated, which leads to cumbersome analysis process and low efficiency. This paper designs the RCS data management and analysis system based on Matlab which can realize the extraction and management of RCS data, and support the efficient development of modeling and analysis.

articleTitle: A monitoring system of home safety environment
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to create an intelligent and comfortable indoor environment, the paper mainly studies the influence of temperature and humidity, external environment, gas concentration, gas quality and lighting conditions on the indoor environment. Using temperature and humidity sensor, gas detector, solar radiation sensor, air quality sensor detected data for intelligent system analysis, so as to create a suitable indoor environment.

articleTitle: Multimodal Image Matching based on Multi-scale Structure Feature
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: To solve the situation that the imaging features of SAR and visible images are widely different in scene matching, a multimodal image matching method using multi-scale structural features is proposed. This method introduces the concept of graph structure, transforms the multimodal image matching problem into a weighted bipartite graph matching problem, extracts the important edge screening nodes from the node attribute similarity and location similarity, constructs a similarity matrix between the template and the real-time image, and obtains the similarity of the two graph structures by solving the matrix. After achieving the extraction of interest regions for graph structure matching, fine matching is performed with LBP texture histogram to finally achieve the precise location of multimodal images. The experiment proves the effectiveness of our method for visible light and SAR image matching is better than other two classical methods.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Aware Based Deep Learning for Credit Card Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: By designing different network topologies or learning models, many research efforts on deep neural networks have focused on improving the accuracy of endpoint predictions and reducing undesired biases in the task of credit card fraud detection. Quantifying uncertainty, as well as point estimates, is important because it lowers model unfairness and aids practitioners in developing dependable systems that prevent making bad decisions due to a lack of confidence. In realworld credit card fraud detection settings, evaluating the uncertainty associated with DNN predictions is critical because fraudsters constantly change their techniques, and as a result, DNN encounters observations that differ from the training distribution, and due to the time-consuming process, few transactions are checked by professional experts in time to update the DNN. As a consequence, this work provides Monte Carlo dropout, ensemble, and ensemble Monte Carlo dropout as three uncertainty quantification methodologies for card fraud detection on transaction data. Forecast uncertainty estimates were also assessed using the UQ confusion matrix and a variety of performance criteria. We show that the ensemble captures the uncertainty associated with generated predictions experimental measurements better than the individual. We also demonstrate that the proposed UQ approach enhances fraud detection by giving more information for point prediction.

articleTitle: Comparison of prediction model for tobacco quality characteristics in central Yunnan province
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Ecological factors are one of the basic conditions for the formation of tobacco quality characteristics. The neural network is used to predict the main ecological and chemical components of flue-cured tobacco in 2019-2020. The results showed that in the relative contribution rate of ecological factors to the chemical components of flue-cured tobacco, the average relative contribution rate of meteorological factors was significantly higher than that of soil and altitude, with an average contribution rate of 69%. The main influencing factors of different chemical components were different. The determination coefficient of multivariate statistical prediction model is about 0.30, while the neural network prediction model is about 0.80, and the RMSE and nRMSE of neural network prediction model are lower than those of multivariate statistical prediction model. Among them, the simulation effect of total sugar and reducing sugar is satisfactory, with nRMSE of 4.68% and 5.54% respectively. The study on the correlation between chemical components and ecological factors of flue-cured tobacco is of great significance to make rational use of climate resources and further improve the intelligent evaluation of flue-cured tobacco quality.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Optimization Algorithm Based on MADDPG
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Multi-agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MADDPG) is a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm, and it has been published for more than 4 years. It has gradually become a classic multi-agent algorithm and one of the basic algorithms that many beginners must learn. However, sometimes the MADDPG algorithm takes a bit too many episodes for the reward value to rise significantly, and sometimes the reward value is not high enough within a certain episode. That is why this paper proposes an algorithm that uses an ensemble method to optimize the MADDPG algorithm. The basic operation idea of the algorithm is to train multiple models simultaneously, then compare the rewards obtained by all models, and select the model with the highest reward to train all models at this stage. After testing in different environments provided by MPE, it is found that this ensemble optimization algorithm based on MADDPG is effective.

articleTitle: Prediction of machine production state based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Aiming at the problem of machine production state prediction in the process of workshop task processing, from the perspective of the correlation between various production states, taking the aluminizing machine required in a flexible workshop as the research object, and based on its production state index data, Bayesian Network (BN) is introduced into the production state prediction of the aluminizing machine. Through BN structure learning and parameter learning, some production states of aluminum plating machine are inferred and predicted. The results show that BN can effectively reflect the correlation between the production states of aluminum plating machine, and can reveal the key factors affecting any production state, to provide a basis for the management of subsequent production links.

articleTitle: A/B Test Research on the Selection of Push Scheme in Network Precision Marketing
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In the information age, network precision marketing is the major concern of Internet operators. As one of the most successful statistical applications, the A/B test has been widely used in the field of making business decisions and has become a powerful tool for solving many online businesses. In this paper, we focus on the issue of the selection of online push strategies under two schemes from both the perspective of Bayesian and likelihood methods. We then further illustrate the effectiveness and applicability of our approach via a real example from "Cookie Cats" dataset, a mobile puzzle game developed by Tactile Entertainment.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Highway Alarm and Warning System
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Aiming at the current situation of frequent highway traffic accidents and secondary accidents, and delayed rescue positioning, this paper designs a highway alarm and warning system. The system collects alarm information, alarm information reports and device linkage warning through highway alarm and warning devices, and carries out the processing of alarm information through the terminal control system, realizing the functions of the system alarms with one key, early warning and device remote control and completing the optimization of the on-site handling process of traffic accidents; therefore, the incidence of secondary accidents is reduced within a certain range.

articleTitle: Research on a Road Network Establishment Method
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: This paper proposes a road network establishment method, including obstacle element extraction based on digital elevation model, terrain road network information analysis, creating roads, creating earth roads and so on. Obstacle feature extraction based on digital elevation model is the basis of road network construction. Creating roads involves creating initial roads, modifying road parameters, expanding roads, creating objects on both sides of the road center and so on. Creating earth roads involves creating initial roads, modifying Road parameters, expanding roads, creating intersections, creating roads in other directions and so on. Based on the above method, the computer modeling of road network is carried out by Unity3D software. Combined with practical application, good results have been achieved.

articleTitle: Development of Digital Media Interactive Roaming System for Virtual Scenic Spots
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to enrich the content and form of interactive virtual roaming in scenic spots, a multimedia interactive roaming system for virtual scenic spots was designed and implemented mainly using tools such as Unity 3D, Maya, Photoshop, SpeedTree, QuixelBridge, Steam VR. The experimental test results show that the created scenic VR scene has beautiful picture, strong interactive performance, good experience effect and stable system performance. By enriching the content of virtual tourism in scenic spots and innovating the form of interactive experience, the quality of scene images has been significantly improved, which can bring realistic experience to users, and also play a positive role in promoting scenic spots.

articleTitle: Research and development of carbon emission monitoring and analysis platform for power plants
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Global warming has a huge impact on our lives, and carbon dioxide, as one of the greenhouse gases, has drawn enormous attention. This paper briefly introduces the carbon emission monitoring and analysis platform based on power plants. First, data indicators such as carbon dioxide concentration and flue gas flow rate are monitored in real time through the CEMS system, and the data indicators are stored in the database. Among them, the carbon dioxide concentration is monitored by the non-dispersive infrared absorption method. Then, through the stored data, the carbon emissions of the power plant are determined using the emission factor method. The carbon emissions of power plants, fossil fuels, and desulfurization are related to the net purchase and use of electricity by enterprises, which need to be calculated separately and finally added up. After that, other functions of the platform are introduced, such as data prediction, monitoring and alarming, and energy consumption monitoring. Finally, through an example analysis and comparing different units, it is concluded that the gasfired unit has the lowest carbon emissions and the lowest carbon emissions per unit of power generation.

articleTitle: New Energy Vehicle Battery SOH Evaluation Method Based on Charging High Quality Data Set Extraction
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In the charging scenario of new energy vehicles, due to the complex and nonlinear electrochemical mechanism of lithium batteries in new energy vehicles, it is difficult to accurately estimate the battery health status by ordinary measurement methods. Aiming at the technical difficulties of poor quality data set and noise sensitive IC curve of data-driven method, an advanced smoothing method based on Adaptive strong tracking untracked Kalman filtering algorithm (ASTUKF) is proposed in this paper. Combined with grey correlation analysis and long-term and short-term neural network, the ASTUKF-GRA-LSTM online SOH estimation model of lithium battery for new energy vehicles is established. The experimental results show that the method is suitable for fast and accurate estimation of SOH of different types of power batteries, improves the calculation accuracy of batteries, and effectively meets the safety analysis requirements of accurate and rapid dynamic evaluation of DC charging piles for lithium battery health status of new energy vehicles.

articleTitle: The face encoder of speech portrait based on the ResNet
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Speech portrait is the research focus in cross-modal recognition. In order to improve the accuracy and specificity of speech portrait, an improved speech-face portrait algorithm is proposed, which includes speech feature encoder and face feature encoder. In the face encoder part, the facial feature extraction network is established based on ResNet-50, and the model parameters are optimized by training on JAFFE and AVSpeech datasets. The visualization of the experimental results shows that the improved model has an ideal effect of facial feature extraction, can encode the main features, and can effectively improve the performance of facial feature extraction.

articleTitle: Intelligent Command System for Emergency Rescue Based on Multiple Communication Methods
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Aiming at the problems of insufficient rescue communication methods and slow networking, this paper takes wireless Mesh network as the support, integrates LoRa, microwave communication, wireless serial communication, 2.4GHZ network and Bluetooth and other communication methods to construct intelligent command system for emergency rescue based on multiple communication methods. The system effectively realizes the precise 3D position monitoring of the rescuers on the scene, the monitoring of the vital signs of the rescuers, the air pressure warning of the respirator, the wireless video monitoring return and the two-way voice interaction, and sends out the safety warning information in time. At the same time, the system can quickly analyze potential dangers at the rescue site and assist the commander in decisionmaking, so as to efficiently complete emergency rescue tasks. Experiments show that the system runs stably, the video is clear and reliable, and the data is accurate in real time.

articleTitle: Design of seat support height based on the analysis of biomechanical characteristics of lumbar and abdomen muscles
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: To improve drivers' comfort, this work calculated the force between L1 to the sacral vertebrae and the activation of the lower back muscles of drivers with lumbar support. The lumbar support was placed at the height of the projection from the human sacrum to the L3 vertebral segment to the chair surface, and the calculation was carried out using the AnyBody Modeling System. The results show that under lumbar support with a backrest angle of 15deg and support protrusion of 4 cm, the intervertebral force and back activation of the driver show a negative correlation as the lumbar support position increases. The ideal lumbar height is the height projected to the chair surface from the L4 vertebral segment. At this height, the force of each vertebral segment increases by 2.71% on average. Except for the erector spine muscle, the activation of other main force-producing muscles in the lumbar and back decreases averagely by 39.8%. In the end, the verification test proved the rationality of the modeling and the reliability of the simulation experiment results. The method adopted lays a foundation of lumbar support design oriented towards the ideal driver’s intervertebral force and back activation and provides references for sat comfort design.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Petrochemical ships based on FAHP-TOPSIS
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The risk of petrochemical ships is an important factor affecting marine ecology and port security. In this paper, we combine the best of the analytic hierarchy process and the approaching ideal solution sorting method to evaluate the ship risk. In order to overcome the subjectivity of weight assignment to a certain extent, we innovatively introduce triangular fuzzy numbers to measure the confidence of experts in this paper. Firstly, 15 representative ships were selected for risk assessment according to the data of ships operating in a petrochemical port. Secondly, we select personnel factors, ship factors and management factors to establish a petrochemical ship risk evaluation index system, and use expert scoring and Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP) to determine the weight of each index. Finally, the ranking result of ship risk is calculated by the method of Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS). The results of this study can be used as a reference for petrochemical ship scheduling in waterways, ports and anchorages.

articleTitle: Statistical Inference of Light Buoy Gyrocenter Based on Kernel Density Estimation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: A statistical inference method based on kernel density estimation is proposed to measure the light buoy gyrocenter. To justify the reasonableness of the statistical inference method, the following contents are mentioned. First, a two-dimensional Gaussian kernel function is used to estimate the probability density function of the latitude and longitude sample. Second, the probability density weighted average of probability density peak is used as a gyrocenter estimated value. Third, the gyration radius is calculated with the gyrocenter and the sample. Finally, the t-test is used to prove the numerical fluctuation cycle of gyration radius is not significantly different from the tidal cycle.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Track Circuit Based on Hierarchical Fuzzy Decision Tree
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In the actual industry, the causes of track circuit failures vary, but the input data collected may be similar. Aiming at this phenomenon, this paper adopts a hierarchical fuzzy decision tree algorithm to analyze the fault data, which combining fuzzy decision tree algorithm and hierarchical information gain theory. Based on the vertical hierarchical structure of fault types, a fault classification model of 25hz phase-sensitive track circuit is established, and the validity is verified by 6 common fault types.

articleTitle: Parametric vibration analysis of stay cables of long-span railway cable-stayed bridges based on BIM technology
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Research purposes: BIM technology is rapidly and far-reaching impact on various fields of bridge construction. With the increase of the span of railway cable-stayed bridge, the problem of cable parametric vibration gradually appears, and it is worth studying to apply BIM technology to the calculation of cable parametric vibration. Taking Hanjiatuo Yangtze River Bridge in Chongqing-Lichuan Railway as the engineering background, the full bridge BIM model is established by CATIA, Through the secondary development of CAA, the dynamic characteristics of the bridge are calculated, the influence of sag effect on cable mode is discussed, and the cable which is prone to parametric vibration is obtained by frequency comparison. The influence of various factors (excitation frequency, excitation amplitude and damping) on cable parametric vibration is discussed by finite element method and numerical integration method, which provides a certain theoretical basis for setting up cable vibration suppression device.

articleTitle: A study of route selection behaviour based on Equate-to-Differentiate theory under the influence of preference reversal
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The route preference reversal phenomenon will lead to inaccurate prediction of route selection considering preferences, which in turn leads to imbalance in the distribution of traffic flows on the road network considering path preferences. To deal with this problem, based on the Equate-to-Differentiate theory, to describe the dynamic change pattern of travelers’s preferences by combining the experience-weighted attractiveness (EWA) learning model and the cumulative reinforcement learning model, then, constructing a model of route selection behavior considering preference reversal. On this basis, Comparison and analysis of the evolution of network traffic flow with considering route preference reversal or not. The algorithm validation shows that: In considering the travelers route preference reversal, road network traffic flow is more balanced under the dynamic update of both preferences.

articleTitle: Automated classification of ocular ultrasonography using CNN
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Ocular ultrasonography interpretation is performed mainly by ophthalmologists, which will take up a lot of time in diagnosis. CNN has not been used to classify ocular ultrasonography. We aim to use deep learning to classify the ocular ultrasonography into seven categories. For this purpose, we introduce an ocular ultrasonography (OUG) dataset which is still extended. The dataset is composed of groundtruth annotation as well as several categories diagnosed by five professional ophthalmologists. We test some models and apply data augmentation strategy to improve the performance. The open-source deep learning framework PyTorch is used to accelerate the deep learning process. After several tests with an iteration of 200 training steps, we choose GoogleNet as our classification model. The validation accuracy of classification is 78.7%.

articleTitle: Design of virtual experiment interface based on visual perception and cognitive load
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: To improve the cognitive effect of virtual experiment interface interaction, from the perspective of visual perception and cognitive load, according to the evaluation requirements for the effectiveness of interactive interface in the process of virtual experiment operation, combined with the characteristics of virtual experiment interactive interface and teaching, this paper analyzes the constituent elements of virtual experiment interface, determines the comprehensive evaluation index, and designs the sampling scheme, The samples are evaluated by fuzzy complete evaluation method. The design strategy of the virtual experiment interface is proposed, which provides a reference for the design of the virtual experiment interface.

articleTitle: Simulation of grinding nickel-based superalloy with electroplated CBN grinding head
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In order to simulate and predict the surface topography of nickel-base superalloy processed by electroplated grinding head, a digital modeling method of electroplated grinding head was proposed, which considered three key factors: abrasive shape, abrasive spacing and abrasive height. The whole digital model of electroplated grinding head was established by random array method driven by basic data and distributed model. On this basis, the finite element simulation and surface morphology prediction of grinding process were realized, and the corresponding grinding experiment of CBN electroplated grinding head were carried out. The comparative analysis shows that the surface profiles of the simulated and experimental workpiece have high similarity under different process parameters.

articleTitle: An optimized parametric simulation model of radar antenna pattern
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Aiming at the antenna pattern simulation problem in radar and electronic warfare simulation systems, an optimized radar antenna pattern parametric simulation model is proposed. Based on the idea of parametric curve interpolation, the Sinc function is extended to fit the side lobes but not only the main lobe, realizing high-precision simulation of the antenna main lobe and multi-level side lobes. On this basis, it is extended to the azimuth-elevation two-dimensional angular space, and a real-time simulation method of the azimuth-elevation two-dimensional pattern suitable for circular antennas, elliptical antennas and rectangular antennas is proposed. Finally, a simulation was carried out to prove the validity of the model. This method greatly reduces the simulation calculation and can meet the real-time calculation requirements of the antenna pattern of the radar electronic warfare simulation system.

articleTitle: An Image Matching Algorithm Based on Bipartite Graph
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In view of the low accuracy and a lot of false matches of traditional image matching algorithm. In order to obtain more accurate results and estimate the transformation between images accurately, this paper proposes an feature points’ matching algorithm based on bipartite graph optimal matching. Firstly, extracting feature points and descriptors from query images and training images and building bipartite graph based on feature points and Euclidean distance of descriptors. The points in the graph are the feature points in two images, one side corresponds to the query image, and the other side corresponds to the training image. The edges are the distances of two points. Further more, setting a threshold where edges with distances less than this threshold are preserved, so a sparse bipartite graph can be obtained. The Time Complexity of this algorithm will decrease because of sparsity. Finally, using bipartite graph optimal matching algorithm Kuhn-munkres to get image matches. The results of experiments show that the quality of image matching is improved.

articleTitle: Research on Rutting Flow Deformation of Asphalt Mixture Mesostructure Based on Discrete Element Method
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: At present, rutting has become one of the main diseases of asphalt pavement. Therefore, improving the anti-rutting performance of asphalt pavement has become an urgent problem to be solved in highway construction. In order to overcome the problems of insufficient equipment conditions, large experimental amount and long experimental period in the rutting experiment of different graded asphalt mixtures in traditional indoor experiments. In this paper, on the basis of the indoor rutting experiment, the PFC(exp 2D) software is used to establish the specimen models of three typical graded asphalt mixtures of suspension-dense type, skeleton-dense type, and skeleton-void type. Through the virtual rutting experiment, the trajectory change law, displacement field and contact force field of three asphalt mixtures in the process of rutting formation were compared and analyzed, hoping to serve as a reference for asphalt pavement design. The results show that the SMA-20 asphalt mixture, the skeleton-dense grading, has better compression resistance, shear resistance and stress transfer ability.

articleTitle: A map construction method based on semantic information in dynamic scenes
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The map construction of static scenes can be well achieved by traditional visual odometry. The preconditions for such static scenes are not suitable for complex real-world environments with moving objects, which are scenes for robotics or autonomous driving. These moving objects can increase the outliers and drift of the constructed map. To solve the problem of increased outliers and larger drift when constructing maps in dynamic scenes, this paper proposes a map construction method that combines visual odometry technology to perform explicit outlier removal and drift correction with semantic information in dynamic scenes. With the aid of the pixel-level semantic information, this method can not only eliminate the outliers of the point cloud in the process of polar line search but also perform depth filtering to eliminate some outliers that do not conform to the scene scale. In addition, to correct the drift of the scene point cloud, this method constructs an accurate global map through loop closure detection in dynamic scenes. Experimental results show that our method can effectively reduce the outliers and drift of point cloud maps in dynamic scenes.

articleTitle: Sleep apnea syndrome screening system based on acceleration sensor
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Sleep apnea syndrome is a common problem at present. It is very important to design a system which can help to monitor sleep problems and analyze sleep quality. In this study, the acceleration sensor mpu9150 and stm32 were used as the main control chip to realize the functions of human body position signal acquisition, analog-to-digital conversion and data transmission. The upper computer judged the number of turns through posture analysis, and analyzed the sleep apnea syndrome. In order to verify the body position signal, this study simulated the right lying position, left lying position, supine position, prone position and sitting up state during human sleep. The experiment results show that the average accuracy of the rollover detection algorithm is 96.67%. It proved that the accelerometer can be used to analyze and process the sleep, awakening time and sleep efficiency in the process of human sleep, so as to judge whether there is sleep apnea syndrome. The system designed in this study is low load, easy to operate and comfortable. It can be used for daily sleep monitoring and sleep apnea syndrome analysis.

articleTitle: An Algorithm of mmWave MIMO Antenna Exposure Based on Unsupervised Deep Learning
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Millimeter wave Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) antenna has been used in 5th generation mobile communication technology to provide a high-qualified service, which also brings new challenges to traditional radiation safety evaluation, especially for numerical radiation simulation. An unsupervised deep learning method is proposed to determine the limit of millimeter wave MIMO terminal antennas radiation accurately and efficiently, providing a new alternative of rapid radiation safety evaluation. We firstly prove the practicality of the proposed method, and then take an example of simulating exposure of different antenna arrays with working frequency 28 GHz in the target plane. In addition, the reliability of the proposed algorithm is compared with Monte Carlo method as a reference. The results show that the error of the maximum and mean power density distribution can be limited up to 0.07% between the two methods.

articleTitle: Monitoring Model of All-sensing Intelligent Station Based on Operating State Evaluation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In the power system, the distribution area is an important infrastructure of the power grid. In the era of smart grid, the dispatching and condition monitoring management of smart distribution area is an important task for power enterprises and power authorities. However, the calculation efficiency of state prediction is low. The real-time performance of data acquisition, analysis and calculation are poor, and the qualified rate of state prediction is low, which affects the safety and stability of power grid operation. In this paper, according to the state monitoring and management of distribution area, the entity of distribution area is converted into data model. The remote monitoring and dispatching are carried out. After the experimental test, compared with the traditional prediction method, we found that the prediction accuracy of the proposed method is improved by 11. 2%, and the calculation time is reduced by more than 6. 7%. With the increase of the amount of data, the algorithm in this paper occupies significantly less system resources, which has a strong practical application value and significance for improving the system operation efficiency and reducing the failure of distribution network equipment.

articleTitle: Study on a Method of Water System Establishment
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In this paper, a hydrographic net establishment method is proposed, including hydrographic net information analysis, creation of rivers, creation of ponds and other steps. The steps involved in creating rivers model include mapping of the channel model, initialization of the rivers model, modification of the rivers model parameters, extension of the rivers model, creation of intersecting rivers model, adjustment of rivers model. The proposed method has achieved better results in combination with practical applications.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection based on IWEasyTL Algorithm
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: To achieve higher network intrusion detection performance in the changing network environment, transfer learning is introduced and a network intrusion detection method based on Iterative and Weighted Easy Transfer Learning (IWEasyTL) algorithm is proposed. The IWEasyTL algorithm is EasyTL-based, but it solves the problem that different features cannot be treated differently in EasyTL. Experimental results show that our method can effectively deal with changes in the network environment and achieve better performance.

articleTitle: Measuring and Modeling the Influences of Street Tree Species on Microclimate and Pedestrian Comfort
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Street trees are important components of urban green spaces, and their ecosystem services improve the urban thermal environment. The shade from the tree cover can create a more comfortable pedestrian space in a city with hot summer. In addition, urban microclimate analyses are becoming more and more to address the planning decision process to create liveable and healthy public spaces. However, the specific relationship between street tree species and microclimate has not been sufficiently studied in diverse urban settings. Therefore, this study took two typical "three boards and four belts" type streets in Nanjing as a study site. The research objective is to investigate how the street tree species affect microclimate and pedestrian comfort. We analyzed the microclimate variations by on-site meteorological measurement. Furthermore, the ENVI-met model was used to analyze the optimal strategies for improving the thermal environment. The human thermal comfort was evaluated by Universal Thermal Climate Index (UTCI), which can be calculated in the model. The results revealed: the microclimate in the streets planted with deciduous trees can create a better thermal environment than conifers. Street trees performed differently by influencing the thermal environment in streets in different directions. Over-dense tree canopy may reduce the vertical air circulation, which leads to the heated air block in the pedestrian spaces. The findings of this study showed great opportunities for supporting decision-makers in improving the urban thermal environment through street greenery.

articleTitle: Research on measurement technology of rapid diagnosis equipment for rural road pavement defects
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In this paper, the detection technology of the fast diagnosis equipment for defects of rural road surface is explored. In view of the characteristics of long mileage, low standard and little capital of rural roads, the quantitative numerical tracing of the road surface defect rapid diagnosis equipment with characteristics of rural roads is carried out, which solves the problem of rapid diagnosis of road surface defects in rural roads. Equipment value traceability issues. This paper expounds the urgency of developing the traceability of the measurement value of rural highway testing equipment, comprehensively evaluates the measurement error level, and establishes a complete traceability path, which can be traced to the national benchmark. For flatness and any, this paper expounds the two indicators of measurement technology and principle, and the measurement of technical indicators, to determine the distance measurement error, IRI measurement error, effective detection width road, the road cut area measurement deviation, parameter calibration of measurement repeatability test method, and the related parameters is verified by experiment. This paper provides a necessary research foundation for the establishment of the standard of rapid diagnosis and measurement of rural road surface defects and fills the gap of measurement technology of rural road testing equipment.

articleTitle: Research on a New Technology of Information Security Protection in Intelligent Substation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Information security is the core of inter-substation security of smart substations. Access to various equipment brings unprecedented risks to the network information security in substations. This paper took countermeasures for the special security demand of data fusion of smart substations, and put forward the security strategy of "security zoning, boundary isolation, wireless protection, standard access, authority classification, and comprehensive protection." An information security zoning scheme was formulated by sorting out the data services of smart substations. Targeted isolation measures were adopted for the information security zone boundaries of multi-station fusion substations based on security zoning. A universal security access zone design scheme based on dual-isolation was proposed for the isolation of internal and external networks. The corresponding information protection strategies were proposed for the wireless sensor networks due to their particularity. A series of solutions for the information security problems caused by information fusion of smart substations were explored based on the above research.

articleTitle: Prediction and Analysis of China's Future Population Development Trend
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Changes in population are related to the future of a country. China is the most populous country in the world. In the past three decades, my country's population policy has made extraordinary achievements in controlling the population. With the development of society and economy, changes in fertility concepts and the emergence of such phenomena as population aging, scientifically understanding the changing laws of population numbers and establishing population models to accurately predict population numbers will help to adjust population policies to better adapt to social and economic development. This paper studies the mathematical model of population forecasting. First, a population index model and a logistic model were established to predict the national population data in 2030. The fitting results showed that the logistic model was more accurate. Secondly, the SPSS time series model is used to predict the male population and urban population data in 2030.

articleTitle: Low power consumption agricultural greenhouse environmental monitoring system design and Implementation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: To ensure the quality of agricultural products, it is essential to monitor crops during planting and growth. In this paper, we develop a Low power consumption agricultural greenhouse environment monitoring system to obtain accurate, realtime, and efficient information on crop growth. With STM32F407, ARM Cortex-M as the core of the acquisition and control unit, the system collects and monitors the temperature, humidity, atmospheric pressure, light intensity and harmful gas index in the growing environment of crops in real-time. The sensor data is transmitted to the server by Narrowband- Internet of Things (NB-IoT) communication technology. We also built a website on the server side to display the corresponding data and control the thresholds remotely. In summary, A real-time crop information monitoring system with long-distance, low power consumption, intellectualization, multi-dimension, and multi-scale is implemented. Users can monitor and control the environment of crops more intuitively by viewing the web interface's text, curve, and picture information. The results show that the system can significantly reduce maintenance costs and simplify operations. The use of this system can effectively improve the economic benefits.

articleTitle: Soil erosion evaluation of RUSLE model based on remote sensing and GIS -- a case study of Taizhou City
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Analysis and evaluation of regional soil erosion can lay the foundation for regional soil and water conservation research work. Combined with the RUSLE model and GIS, the soil erosion in Taizhou was calculated and evaluated. The results present that the average soil erosion amount in Taizhou in 2021 is 11.02 million t/a, and the average soil erosion modulus is 1160 t/(km(exp 2)*a), which belongs to slight erosion. Among them, Xianju County, Huangyan District, Linhai City, Tiantai County, and Sanmen County have more serious soil erosion, and the amount of soil erosion risks is jumping to higher risks. It is necessary to strengthen supervision and management.

articleTitle: Traffic Sparing Algorithm for Multi-Layer Multi-Domain Optical Networks Based on Matching Game
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: A matching game based multicast traffic sparse algorithm is proposed for multicast traffic sparse problem in multi-layer multi-domain optical network by fusing matching game and heuristic algorithm. The heuristic algorithm is optimized and the nodes in the optical network are matched effectively to achieve the traffic sparing purpose. The algorithm analysis and experimental results show that the algorithm is significantly effective in reducing the number of transceivers in the optical network, while reducing the network resources and cost investment, and substantially alleviating the possible blocking situation in multicast services.

articleTitle: DDoS attack model with detection accuracy feedback mechanism
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Due to the lack of pertinence to specific types of attacks in the existing models, a kind of model specially suitable for DDoS attacks is constructed based on the malicious behavior knowledge base with feedback mechanism. Based on the classical SIR model, the model introduces the actual attack stage of DDoS attack, and the detection accuracy feedback mechanism can continuously improve the detection accuracy of the model and effectively control the scale of DDoS attack. The equilibrium point of the new model is calculated, and the propagation threshold of the model is obtained by the next generation matrix theory. Then the local stability and global stability of the equilibrium point of the model are proved by Routh-Hurwitz criterion and Lyapunov function. The experimental results show that constructing a DDoS attack model with feedback mechanism can more effectively resist DDoS attacks by improving its own detection ability.

articleTitle: Application of Traffic Loading in Southern Africa Code System for Conventional Bridge Design
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: More and more Chinese companies are participating in infrastructure projects such as highways around the world, which increasing requirements for Chinese engineers and technicians to master and apply design specifications in different countries and regions. This paper, based on the Maputo Bypass Project in Mozambique, introduces traffic loading defined in SATCC (Southern Africa Transport and Communications Commission) Code comprehensively, and compares it with which in Chinese Code system. Through calculation and analysis of the actual prefabricated bridges with medium and small spans, the differences of the internal force effect due to the two types of vehicle loads are obtained. The main research conclusions: The number of lanes specified in SATCC is more conservative than in the Chinese code. The NA uniform lane load in SATCC is about 2.4 to 4.9 times that in Chinese code, and the NA axle load is 0.32 to 0.45 of Chinese code. The NB load in SATCC can be used as a vehicle load globally and locally for the structural analysis. The wheel load, axle load and total weight of BN36, for instance, are 1.286, 2.571, and 2.618 times of Chinese truck load respectively. The combination factors of SATCC traffic loads are generally greater than those of Chinese code, but traffic loads are not considered with some particular effects simultaneously in certain load cases in SATCC. The difference of the hogging moment effects of the continuous beam section above piers between the two codes is the most significant, which makes the main difference for the bridge design. The internal force effects produced by traffic loads of SATCC are greater than those of Chinese code. However, the gap narrows down as the span of beam increases. Abovementioned conclusions are as references for the design of conventional bridges in southern Africa.

articleTitle: Global path planning of intelligent vehicle based on improved bidirectional parallel A* algorithm
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: At present, the global path planning of intelligent vehicle has the problems of long search time, many redundant points, low path smoothness and low applicability of intelligent vehicle. To solve these disadvantages, this paper proposes an improved bidirectional parallel A* algorithm as the global path planning algorithm. The traditional A* algorithm is improved by using bidirectional parallel search of start and end points, setting safe distance and redefining heuristic function. Aiming at the problem that there are many redundant points in the path planned by the traditional A* algorithm, the measures of selecting key turning points and using cubic B-spline curve for path smoothing are proposed. The final simulation results show that the planned global path has good effect and can meet the requirements of intelligent vehicle follow-up control. The improved bidirectional parallel A* algorithm has the characteristics of fast search speed, less redundant points and high smoothness of the planned path.

articleTitle: Geo-Distributed Data Analytics Using Novel Cloud Resource Provisioning Method
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: With the increasing demands for cloud&network convergence computing over big data analytics, the problem of balancing the utilization of cloud resource and optimization of query response time has become more and more urgent. As a result, the selection of optimal data transmission path is considered as the top priority. The paper proposes an optimized cloud resource provisioning and allocating method to execute cross domain data analytics. As the experiments results shown, compared with the baseline approach, the proposed method presents a great significance for the prospect of applications which rely on cloud resource allocation.

articleTitle: The research on building electromagnetic environment of communication countermeasure training
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Training is the important way to enhance battle effectiveness. If we want to win the future war, we must put the training in the combat environment similar to the future war. Communication is the most important link in the battlefield, which directly affects the choice and application of combat opportunities, weapons and equipment, and combat methods. This paper discusses the communication countermeasure training environment construction principles, methods and processes, analyzes the similarity index of communication countermeasure training environment, and gives examples to analyze the electromagnetic environment constructed, which can be used for reference to enhance the training effect and improve the combat effectiveness and equipment development of the army.

articleTitle: Research on a new generation of information technology based road tunnel supervision platform
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: This paper addresses the outstanding problems of China's road tunnels at this stage, by establishing a set of tunnel traffic safety management platform covering "prevention in advance, accurate detection in the process, and effective retrospection afterwards", breaking through the traditional tunnel sensing, data fusion, data prediction and other key technologies, realising the multi-functional coupling of the system, the inter-system It enables multi-functional coupling of systems, information collaboration between systems, and intelligent monitoring of the whole life cycle of tunnel electromechanics. The accurate prediction of traffic flow in tunnels not only effectively improves the information management of road tunnels, but also provides strong support for China to accelerate the construction of a strong transportation country.

articleTitle: Research on carbon emission calculation methods and emission reduction measures during the construction period of asphalt pavement
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: The transportation industry is a key area of greenhouse gas emission reduction in China, and the construction of highway asphalt pavement generates a large amount of carbon dioxide, which is the focus of emission reduction. By analyzing the characteristics of carbon emission during asphalt pavement construction, the calculation method of carbon emission during asphalt pavement construction is studied by LCA, and the carbon emission and heat source in the whole construction process are obtained based on a highway case. The results show that in the process of asphalt pavement construction, the total emission in the raw material production stage and mixing stage is up to 92.23%. The emission reduction measures are mainly to actively use clean fuel and improve the efficiency of production equipment. During the paving of water stabilized base / subbase, the carbon emission in the production stage of raw materials is as high as 90% of the total amount, and the emission reduction measures are mainly low-carbon cement.

articleTitle: Research on a Basic Model of Electronic Countermeasure Simulation
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: This paper presents a basic model of electronic countermeasure simulation, including antenna gain calculation basic model, radio wave propagation calculation basic model, radar jamming parameter simulation basic model and communication jamming parameter simulation basic model. Combined with the actual project, good results have been achieved.

articleTitle: Compact sensor for rapid detection of micro water content based on laser spectroscopy
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In this paper, the charged detection of H2O and HF is based on the infrared laser spectroscopy technology. It is precisely by using the strong and independent characteristic absorption peaks of H2O and HF in the infrared band. According to the Lambert Beer law, through the laser light source with specific frequency and high selectivity, the most adaptive spectral detection technology is selected to comprehensively study the material characteristics of the optical path system and the adsorption of the material of the optical gas absorption cell. Design and develop infrared laser spectrum charged detection device with detection sensitivity ≤1ppm, quickly detect the equipment hidden dangers or intermediate products in the initial process of failure, determine the nature and development degree of failure, fill the gap of H2O and HF charged detection at home and abroad, improve the evaluation means of the operation status of the SF6 electrical equipment, and further effectively ensure safe and stable operation of equipment.

articleTitle: Research on the Design and Development of Transportation Management Information System
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: As China's new economy continues to develop, innovative reforms in various industries and people's diversified needs have placed higher demands on the development of the transportation industry. However, the constant frequency of traffic safety accidents and exposed road safety hazards have seriously threatened the lives of our traffic personnel and the development of the transportation industry. Based on this current situation, this paper designs and develops transportation management information system based on technologies such as big data analysis and computer applications. This system combines the intelligent controllability of artificial intelligence and the high automation process of computer to design and develop corresponding functional modules for the problems existing in the original transportation management model, to realize intelligent and efficient transportation management, to effectively meet the development needs of transportation industry, to further ensure the rapid development of China's transportation industry, and to greatly reduce the incidence of traffic safety accidents.

articleTitle: Evaluation system of hub airport parking building project based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: With the rapid development of social economy and the gradual improvement of the public road network around the airport, more and more passengers who choose public transportation such as self-driving, cab and online taxi to and from the airport bring new challenges to the management way of roadside traffic. The construction of parking building rating system has always been a hot topic in the industry, but not many hub airport parking building evaluation system is clearly proposed. This study draws on the design points of traditional parking buildings, combines the unique design points of airport parking buildings, and establishes a set of quantitative evaluation system based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method applicable to hub airport parking buildings. The evaluation system is finally demonstrated by using the P2 and P8 parking projects of Guangzhou Baiyun Airport.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Reversible Data Hiding in Encrypted Domain
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: At present, with the rise of cloud computing and the wide application of cloud storage, the security problem of data storage also appears. Reversible data hiding is an emerging research direction of information hiding technology. As an significant combination of encryption technology and data hiding technology, reversible information hiding in ciphertext domain can play a double insurance role for information security in the process of data processing. Aiming at the current technical requirements of reversible data hiding technology in ciphertext domain, this paper introduces the related researches on reversible data hiding in ciphertext domain, makes technical analysis of representative algorithms under different architectures, and points out their advantages and limitations. Finally, combined with the existing research status and evaluation system, some suggestions for improvement and directions for improvement are put forward.

articleTitle: Construction of Employer Reputation Evaluation Dimension of Crowdsourcing Platform based on Reviews Text Mining
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Reputation evaluation mechanism is the basic guarantee for the healthy, orderly, and rapid development of crowdsourcing activities. Aiming at the lack of the employer reputation evaluation mechanism in crowdsourcing platforms, an employer reputation evaluation dimension based on text data mining is proposed. Taking the reviews text of the workers of a crowdsourcing platform as a case set, this paper uses the TF-IDF algorithm to extract the text features and analyzes some factors affecting the employer's reputation that the workers pays attention to and attaches importance to through keyword co-occurrence and social network analysis. Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) is used for text topic clustering, and extract eight dimensions that effect the reputation of employers, namely explicit demand, smooth communication, timely payment, specialty, patient and meticulous, trust and consideration, cooperation experience, cooperation willingness. This study is of great significance to improve the employer reputation evaluation mechanism of the crowdsourcing platform, truly feedback on the employer reputation, and improve the performance of crowdsourcing tasks.

articleTitle: Group member's importance evaluation algorithm based on identity similarity
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Research on the importance ranking of members in a certain group is an important branch in social-network, but the existing importance algorithms ignore the influence of the members' identities differences on the importance assessment. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a K-shell Level based on Identity Similarity (KSL-IS) algorithm to measure the importance of social network members. According to the group members’ link structure, the KSL-IS algorithm defines the identity similarity among members, integrates the location characteristics of members and the influence of neighbourhood members, and comprehensively evaluates the importance of members. This study used four different complex networks as experimental data, compared with existing algorithms, and verified by the Susceptible-Infectious (SI) propagation performance experiment, robustness test, and Kendall correlation coefficient. The investigation showed that the KSL-IS algorithm is more accurate to measure the importance of members in the group. This study verifies that identity and location characteristics should be taken into account when calculating the importance of members.

articleTitle: A review of research on multi-cloud management platforms
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Due to the rapid development of cloud computing, more and more enterprises are adopting multi-cloud for IT delivery. Because of the heterogeneity of multi-cloud platform hardware resources and virtualization systems, how to scientifically manage and reasonably use various cloud resources is a key issue that needs to be solved urgently in a multi-cloud environment. However, there is still a lack of relevant work to systematically sort out and summarize the research on the multi-cloud management platform. In response to the above problems, this article summarizes the research progress of multi-cloud management platforms. This paper analyses the industrial multi-cloud management platforms and the existing multi-cloud management platform architecture technology from shallow to in-depth and points out the limitations of mainstream multi-cloud management platforms in multi-cloud docking as well as the adaptation modules. Further, we also analyse the difficulties and challenges in the research of multi-cloud management platform architecture. Finally, a summary is made to provide a more comprehensive reference opinion for a more comprehensive understanding of multicloud management and how to formulate a multi-cloud management platform construction plan on demand as well as future prospect research work.

articleTitle: Deep Q-Network Based on Important Experience Replay
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: Although traditional prioritized experience replay effectively improves the learning efficiency of experience data, it also causes problems such as loss of sample diversity and additional consumption of computing resources. The loss of sample diversity easily leads to the difficulty of algorithm convergence, and the consumption of extra computing resources leads to the slow running speed of the algorithm. In this paper, the Deep Q-Network based on important experience replay (DQN-IER) is proposed. First, the dual experience memory structure is designed in the DQN-IER algorithm, which divides the experience data into general experience data and important experience data and stores them separately. Then, general experience and important experience are alternately extracted in the process of algorithm execution, which can effectively improve the learning efficiency of experience data and avoid the problem of sample diversity loss. Finally, the mountain car, cart pole and pendulum control task from the OpenAI Gym were selected as the experimental environment for comparison experiments. The experimental results show that DQN-IER performs better than DQN and DQN-PER, which can effectively reduce the training cost.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Production Line Control System Integrating Oracle and Blockchain
publicationTitle: ISCTT 2022; 7th International Conference on Information Science, Computer Technology and Transportation
abstract: In the traditional industrial production line scenario, it is difficult to grasp the real-time operation of the equipment in the production line, which affects the decision-making and control of the overall production. At the same time, in the process of remote control and data processing of production line equipment using industrial Ethernet, it is easy to have cyber security accidents such as production data leakage. To address these problems, this paper designs a production line control system that combines digital twin technology as well as blockchain and prophecy machine technologies. This proposal explores three aspects, namely, the establishment of the virtual production line, the transmission and processing of realtime production data, and the real-time mapping and optimization adjustment of the production line; the technical means to build this system are introduced in detail, and the feasibility of this system is verified theoretically.
